title: May We Be Faithful and True
summary: The Lord is watching over His kingdom. He is inspiring its leadership to care for its ever-growing membership.

title: Washed Clean
summary: Imagine the consoling, liberating, exalting feeling that will come to you when you see the reality of the Atonement and the practical, everyday value of it to you individually.

title: “From Whom All Blessings Flow”
summary: The redeeming presence of our loving Father-God in the universe is the … supernal truth which, along with His plan of happiness, reigns preeminent and imperial over all other realities.

title: “True to the Truth”
summary: [Your] most important stewardship is the glorious responsibility your Father in Heaven has given you to watch over and care for your own soul.

title: Eternity Lies before Us
summary: Maintaining our spiritual strength is … a daily challenge. The greatest source of that spiritual strength comes … from our temples.

title: Statistical Report 1996
summary: Presented by F. Michael Watson gives the statistical report 1996

title: “Bishop, Help!”
summary: The burden [of a bishop] is a heavy one that cannot be fulfilled without the supportive efforts of ward officers and members.

title: Finding Safety in Counsel
summary: We may know that the warning is from the Lord [when] the law of witnesses, authorized witnesses, has been invoked. When the words of prophets seem repetitive, that should rivet our attention.

title: “Because She Is a Mother”
summary: If you try your best to be the best parent you can be, you will have done all that a human being can do and all that God expects you to do.

title: The Basics Have Not Changed
summary: Learn to be … obedient above all things—that you might be able to carry out the Lord’s work in the majestic way in which it must be done.

title: Power of the Priesthood
summary: Caring for others is the very essence of priesthood responsibility. It is the power to bless, to heal, and to administer the saving ordinances of the gospel.

title: They Will Come
summary: Let us, with faith unwavering and with love unstinting, be bridge builders to the hearts of those with whom we labor.

title: Converts and Young Men
summary: Every convert is precious. Every convert is a son or daughter of God. Every convert is a great and serious responsibility.

title: They Showed the Way
summary: Jesus Christ, Savior of the world … was and is the ultimate pioneer, for He has gone before, showing all others the way to follow.

title: Jesus Christ, Our Redeemer
summary: The Redeemer loves you and will help you do the essential things that bring happiness now and forever.

title: “You Have Nothing to Fear from the Journey”
summary: No matter how difficult the trail … we can take comfort in knowing that others before us have borne life’s most grievous trials and tragedies by looking to heaven.

title: “True to the Faith”
summary: With so great an inheritance, we can do no less than our very best. Those who have gone before expect this of us. We have a mandate from the Lord.

title: “That Spirit Which Leadeth to Do Good”
summary: The Holy Ghost will be our constant companion if we submit ourselves to the will of our Father in Heaven.

title: Endure and Be Lifted Up
summary: [The] responsibility to endure is uniquely yours. But you are never alone. I testify that the lifting power of the Lord can be yours.

title: “Pray unto the Father in My Name”
summary: When we use these sacred words, “in the name of Jesus Christ,” … we are on holy ground.

title: “When Thou Art Converted, Strengthen Thy Brethren”
summary: To become one in the family of Saints requires established members of the Church to warmly welcome new members with open arms.

title: Our Testimony to the World
summary: God is at the helm. We will seek His direction. We will listen to the still, small voice of revelation. And we will go forward as He directs.

title: Pioneers All
summary: My young sisters, we really don’t know how much good we can do until we put forth the effort.

title: Drawing Nearer to the Lord
summary: God is our Father, who watches over His kingdom. Jesus is the Christ, whose name this Church bears. He stands at its head.

title: Called to Serve
summary: It is not in the proper spirit for us to decide where we will serve or where we will not. We serve where we are called.

title: Four Absolute Truths Provide an Unfailing Moral Compass
summary: There is a loving Father in Heaven, and His Son, Jesus Christ; there is an adversary—Satan; through agency, all of us choose our own course; the temptations of the devil can always be overcome.

title: Spiritual Capacity
summary: We need an example—someone to show us how spiritual capacity can be developed. I have selected as a model … President Gordon B. Hinckley.

title: Teach the Children
summary: Children learn through gentle direction and persuasive teaching. They search for models to imitate, knowledge to acquire, things to do, and teachers to please.

title: “Apply the Atoning Blood of Christ”
summary: Christ paid such an enormous, enabling price for us! Will we not apply His Atonement in order to pay the much smaller price required for personal progress?

title: In Remembrance of Jesus
summary: Jesus is the great Mediator. Though omnipotent and omniscient, all-powerful and all-knowing, He is our friend.

title: Valued Companions
summary: In … Church meetings around the world, we come together seeking companionship—the good company of brothers and sisters in the gospel and the comfort of sweet communion with the Spirit of God.

title: Why Every Member a Missionary?
summary: How seriously have you personally taken the Lord’s charge to share His gospel? It is a lifelong responsibility … to be addressed differently according to the various seasons of your life.

title: Standing for Truth and Right
summary: Standing for truth and right is not solely a Sunday thing. Every day our neighborhoods and communities are in desperate need of our support and our commitment to safety and law and order.

title: Pioneers of the Future: “Be Not Afraid, Only Believe”
summary: We belong to the greatest cause on earth. We are the pioneers of the future. Let us go forth like the armies of Helaman and build the kingdom of God.

title: Home Teaching—a Divine Service
summary: Can we … reach out to those for whom we are responsible and bring them to the table of the Lord to feast on His word and to enjoy the companionship of His Spirit?

title: Some Thoughts on Temples, Retention of Converts, and Missionary Service
summary: May you look upon the Church as your great and good friend, your refuge when the world appears to be closing around you, your hope when things are dark, your pillar of fire.

title: The Weightier Matters of the Law: Judgment, Mercy, and Faith
summary: We are to focus on the inward things of the heart, which we know and value intuitively but often neglect for that which is trivial, superficial, or prideful.

title: Receive Truth
summary: Gaining a knowledge of Him is fundamental to our mortal training. We also need to have a thirst and a desire to become acquainted with the doctrines of the kingdom.

title: “He Hath Filled the Hungry with Good Things”
summary: Everything in the gospel teaches us that we can change if we need to, that we can be helped if we truly want it, that we can be made whole, whatever the problems of the past.

title: Look to the Future
summary: The key to the success of the work will be the faith of all who call themselves Latter-day Saints.

title: Hymn of the Obedient: “All Is Well”
summary: What a wonderful future we have for the Church. All of these things are dependent upon how we accept the truth, how we live the principles of the gospel.

title: Following the Pioneers
summary: Do you, like the pioneers, have the courage and the consistency to be true to the faith and endure to the end?

title: “Feed My Lambs”
summary: The Saints of God have always been under covenant to nourish each other spiritually, especially those tender in the gospel.

title: Latter-day Saints in Very Deed
summary: I love you. I love the people of this Church. I love all who are faithful. I love all who follow the ways of the Lord.

title: The Mighty Strength of the Relief Society
summary: May we gain knowledge through study. May we make home a heaven. May we find joy in service.

title: We Bear Witness of Him
summary: Let us be true disciples of the Christ, observing the Golden Rule, doing unto others as we would have them do unto us.

title: Live the Commandments
summary: Take advantage of this great opportunity in your life to live it well, to be good, to have good works, and to influence other people for good.

title: Teaching Our Children to Love the Scriptures
summary: Through the guidance of loving parents and dedicated teachers, small children can become familiar with the scriptures and the spirit that accompanies them.

title: The Time to Prepare
summary: The days of our probation are numbered, but none of us knows the number of those days. Each day of preparation is precious.

title: “Search Me, O God, and Know My Heart”
summary: Ordinances and covenants … are the vehicles the Lord has provided to conduct us into eternal life.

title: Statistical Report, 1997
summary: Statistical Report, 1997

title: The Articles of Faith
summary: If you will use them as a guide to direct your studies of the Savior’s doctrine, you will find yourselves prepared to declare your witness of the restored, true church of the Lord.

title: “A Teacher Come from God”
summary: We must revitalize and reenthrone superior teaching in the Church—at home, from the pulpit, in our administrative meetings, and surely in the classroom.

title: Christ Can Change Human Behavior
summary: When our converts “come alive”—and they need nourishment—in the gospel, they soon come alive as students, as parents, in their professions, and as citizens.

title: Marvelous Are the Revelations of the Lord
summary: We need to embrace, study, and appreciate the revealed truths that are ours. We need to declare the gospel generously and kindly to all of our Father’s children.

title: A New Harvest Time
summary: A new era of family history work has arrived.

title: “Put Your Shoulder to the Wheel”
summary: Work is always a spiritual necessity even if, for some, work is not an economic necessity.

title: “We Seek After These Things”
summary: We hope you are men who are “true at all times in whatsoever thing [you are] entrusted.” [Alma 53:20] … I plead for greater consistency between our beliefs and actions.

title: In Harm’s Way
summary: There is a battle of significant consequence taking place in the lives of young men today. In simple terms, it is the struggle between doing right or doing wrong.

title: Living Worthy of the Girl You Will Someday Marry
summary: Make yourself worthy of the loveliest girl in all the world. Keep yourself worthy through all the days of your life.

title: Look to God and Live
summary: Whenever we are inclined to feel burdened down with the blows of life, let us remember that others have passed the same way, have endured, and then have overcome.

title: Have You Been Saved?
summary: As Latter-day Saints use the words saved and salvation, there are at least six different meanings.

title: That We May Be One
summary: The Savior of the world spoke of that unity and how we will have our natures changed to make it possible.

title: Testimony
summary: This thing which we call testimony is the great strength of the Church. It is the wellspring of faith and activity. It is difficult to explain. It is difficult to quantify … , yet it is as real and powerful as any force on the earth.

title: The Relief Society
summary: Sisters, you must graduate from thinking that you only attend Relief Society to feeling that you belong to it!

title: “Behold, We Count Them Happy Which Endure”
summary: We cannot expect to learn endurance in our later years if we have developed the habit of quitting when things get difficult now.

title: Removing Barriers to Happiness
summary: Appreciation for ethnic, cultural, or national heritage can be very wholesome and beneficial, but it can also perpetuate patterns of life that should be set aside by a devoted Latter-day Saint.

title: New Temples to Provide “Crowning Blessings” of the Gospel
summary: May the windows of heaven be opened and blessings be showered down upon us as a people as we walk with boldness and in faith before the Lord to accomplish His eternal work.

title: How Near to the Angels
summary: You will become great women if you are united in the angelic cause of doing good and if you hunger and thirst after righteousness.

title: Welcome to Conference
summary: With prayer and faith and in humility, testimony is borne to you. May we all be inspired together. May our hearts be lifted in praise to our Redeemer.

title: Are We Keeping Pace?
summary: Every council … should be working together on ways to be more effective in preparing our members … to enjoy all the blessings of the Church and … the temple.

title: Healing Soul and Body
summary: If we seek the truth, develop faith in Him, and … sincerely repent, we will receive a spiritual change of heart which only comes from our Savior. Our hearts will become new again.

title: Think to Thank
summary: Do we give thanks to God “for his unspeakable gift” [2 Cor. 9:15] and His rich blessings so abundantly bestowed upon us?

title: Parents in Zion
summary: I do want to encourage leaders to carefully consider the home lest they issue calls or schedule activities which place an unnecessary burden on parents and families.

title: Cultivating Divine Attributes
summary: We will attain new levels of spirituality and place our lives in closer harmony with Jesus the Christ based on how fully faith, hope, and charity become integral components of our lives.

title: A Voice of Warning
summary: Our ability to touch others with our warning voice matters to all who are covenant disciples of Jesus Christ.

title: Sustaining the Prophets
summary: The gospel is true; it is the hope of the world; it will move onward to accomplish all that it must do.

title: The Aaronic Priesthood and the Sacrament
summary: Those who hold the Aaronic Priesthood open the door for all Church members who worthily partake of the sacrament to enjoy the companionship of the Spirit of the Lord and the ministering of angels.

title: The Priesthood Quorum
summary: Resolve now to do all within your power to make of your priesthood quorum one worthy of the name and one faithful to its mission.

title: “As for Me and My House, We Will Serve the Lord”
summary: There is not anything a young man can do that will be any more important than serving a full-time mission.

title: “By What Power … Have Ye Done This?”
summary: The priesthood of God has become the eminent power for good in the world. … This great power … has been entrusted to us; we must not weaken it by failing in our responsibilities.

title: Today Determines Tomorrow
summary: Let each of us learn of Him, believe in Him, trust in Him, follow Him, obey Him. By so doing we can become like Him.

title: To the Boys and to the Men
summary: I am suggesting that the time has come to get our houses in order.

title: Opening the Windows of Heaven
summary: Tithing is a principle that is fundamental to the personal happiness and well-being of the Church members worldwide, both rich and poor.

title: Hope through the Atonement of Jesus Christ
summary: Real hope is much more than wishful musing. It stiffens, not slackens, the spiritual spine.

title: The Power of Righteousness
summary: Choosing to do what the Lord has defined as right will, in the long run, always lead to the best outcomes.

title: What Are People Asking about Us?
summary: I … wish to set forth, as simply as I know how, my response to what people are asking.

title: Youth of the Noble Birthright
summary: The only lasting joy and happiness you will ever find during your mortal experience will come by following the Savior.

title: Personal Purity
summary: One who uses the God-given body of another without divine sanction abuses the very soul of that individual, abuses the central purpose and processes of life.

title: Establishing the Church
summary: Establishing His Church is a unique assignment. We must take the gospel of Jesus Christ to all people in their own language without defiling the purity of the message.

title: The Living Prophet: Our Source of Pure Doctrine
summary: The Church is founded on continuing revelation to a current, living prophet.

title: We Are Children of God
summary: Who are we? We are children of God. Our potential is unlimited. Our inheritance is sacred.

title: Benediction
summary: These are momentous times in which we are living as Saints of the Most High. … Let us go on rearing our children in righteousness and truth. Let us be good neighbors and good friends.

title: Walking in the Light of the Lord
summary: My message to you, my challenge to you, my prayer is that you will rededicate yourselves to the strengthening of your homes.

title: The Work Moves Forward
summary: The Church goes forward on its appointed mission in the direction of its appointed destiny.

title: Teach Them the Word of God with All Diligence
summary: Our teaching will be effective if we approach it humbly through prayer and study.

title: The Hands of the Fathers
summary: Surely the greatest of those things [required of fathers] will be to have done all they could for the happiness and spiritual safety of the children they are to nurture.

title: This Is Our Day
summary: The marvels of modern science and technology will not exalt us. Indeed, the great challenge we face as we prepare for the future is to be more spiritually enlightened.

title: Statistical Report, 1998
summary: Statistical Report for 1998

title: “Repent of [Our] Selfishness” (D&C 56:8)
summary: Meekness is the real cure, for it does not merely mask selfishness but dissolves it!

title: Receive the Temple Blessings
summary: It is a place of peace, solitude, and inspiration. Regular attendance will enrich your life with greater purpose.

title: Strengthening Families: Our Sacred Duty
summary: The key to strengthening our families is having the Spirit of the Lord come into our homes. The goal of our families is to be on the strait and narrow path.

title: The Witness: Martin Harris
summary: One of Martin Harris’s greatest contributions to the Church, for which he should be honored for all time, was his financing the publication of the Book of Mormon.

title: Our Sacred Duty to Honor Women
summary: Thank the Lord for these sisters who—like our Heavenly Father—love us not only for what we are but for what we may become.

title: Obedience: The Path to Freedom
summary: Obedience leads to true freedom. The more we obey revealed truth, the more we become liberated.

title: The Priesthood—Mighty Army of the Lord
summary: One of the greatest safeguards we have in the Church is a strong, firm, committed, dedicated, and testifying Melchizedek Priesthood base.

title: The Shepherds of the Flock
summary: I carry in my heart a deep appreciation for our bishops. I am profoundly grateful for the revelation of the Almighty under which this office was created and functions.

title: For I Was Blind, but Now I See
summary: If you want to give a light to others, you have to glow yourself.

title: The Bishop and His Counselors
summary: The Church is no bigger than a ward. … Everything needed for our redemption, save for the temple, is centered there—and temples now come ever closer to all of us.

title: Love and Service
summary: Let me just remind all of you of the great need we have … for couple missionaries. … If you’re retired and wondering what to do with those extra years, there’s a world out there of excitement.

title: “He Is Not Here, but Is Risen”
summary: These simple words—“He is not here, but is risen”—have become the most profound in all literature. … They are the fulfillment of all He had spoken concerning rising again.

title: The Power of Teaching Doctrine
summary: We can teach even a child to understand the doctrine of Jesus Christ. It is therefore possible, with God’s help, to teach the saving doctrine simply.

title: Inspired Church Welfare
summary: The Savior, who set the pattern for us, is pleased with those who “remember in all things the poor and the needy, the sick and the afflicted” [D&C 52:40].

title: Like a Flame Unquenchable
summary: One thing is certain: the commandments have not changed. … Right is still right. Wrong is still wrong, no matter how cleverly cloaked in respectability or political correctness.

title: Thanks to the Lord for His Blessings
summary: Great are our blessings. Tremendous is our responsibility. Let us … march forward without fear to enlarge among people everywhere the righteousness of the Lord.

title: Your Celestial Journey
summary: There will come those teaching times to each of you when you will witness the love of your mother, the strength of your father, and the inspiration of God.

title: Find the Lambs, Feed the Sheep
summary: From a satellite broadcast given at the Salt Lake Tabernacle 21 February 1999

title: Welcome to Conference
summary: The Church grows ever larger. It touches more and more lives for good. It is spreading over the earth in a wonderful way.

title: Lessons from Laman and Lemuel
summary: Laman and Lemuel became rebels instead of leaders, resentful instead of righteous—all because of their failure to understand either the character or the purposes of God.

title: Prophets and Spiritual Mole Crickets
summary: In modern Israel, serving the Lord means carefully following the Prophets.

title: Becoming Our Best Selves
summary: When we [trust in the Lord], we will come to realize that we have been on His holy errand, that His divine purposes have been fulfilled, and that we have shared in that fulfillment.

title: The Spirit of Revelation
summary: Young Latter-day Saints, shape up! Face up! Take hold of your lives! Take control of your mind, your thoughts!

title: Do Not Delay
summary: Nephi was right. God gives no commandments to the children of men save He prepares a way for them to obey. However difficult our circumstances, we can repent.

title: “An High Priest of Good Things to Come”
summary: Some blessings come soon, some come late, and some don’t come until heaven; but for those who embrace the gospel of Jesus Christ, they come.

title: Growing into the Priesthood
summary: The Atonement of Jesus Christ has given the Savior the power to help you grow into the young man He knows you can be.

title: Of Seeds and Soils
summary: We particularly want you young men to have a strong testimony, with solid roots, because only then will it be an unerring compass for you.

title: Priesthood Power
summary: The priesthood is not really so much a gift as it is a commission to serve, a privilege to lift, and an opportunity to bless the lives of others.

title: Why We Do Some of the Things We Do
summary: This … is not a cause of ease nor a work without effort, even sacrifice. We shall go on pursuing the path which the Lord has marked out before us.

title: Hope, an Anchor of the Soul
summary: Our greatest hope comes from the knowledge that the Savior broke the bands of death. … He atoned for our sins if we repent.

title: Beware of False Prophets and False Teachers
summary: Beware of those who speak and publish in opposition to God’s true prophets.

title: A Testimony of the Book of Mormon
summary: When you read the Book of Mormon, concentrate on the principal figure in the book—from its first chapter to the last—the Lord Jesus Christ.

title: At the Summit of the Ages
summary: May God bless us with a sense of our place in history and … our need to stand tall and walk with resolution in a manner becoming the Saints of the Most High.

title: A Year of Jubilee
summary: Let us place higher priority on family prayer, family scripture study, and family home evenings and eliminate those activities that fill our lives with worldliness and evil.

title: Gospel Teaching
summary: In our sacred callings of gospel teaching, no effort is too good for the work of the Lord and the growth of His children.

title: He Lives
summary: He [Jesus Christ] has given His life that even in our weakness, we may overcome our mistakes through repentance and obedience to His gospel.

title: Good-bye to This Wonderful Old Tabernacle
summary: The Spirit of the Lord has been in this [Tabernacle]. It is sacred unto us. We hope, we anticipate, we pray that the new [Conference Center] will likewise radiate the same spirit.

title: What It Means to Be a Daughter of God
summary: The commitment and dedication of the sisters of this Church have been since the beginning a marvelous, strengthening ingredient.

title: To All the World in Testimony
summary: In this great hall … the voices of prophets will go out to all the world in testimony of the Redeemer of mankind.

title: The Cloven Tongues of Fire
summary: In every language, the Spirit of God—the Holy Ghost—guides, or can guide, every member of the Church.

title: Resurrection
summary: Resurrection is much more than merely reuniting a spirit to a body. … The resurrection is a restoration that brings back “carnal for carnal” and “good for that which is good” (Alma 41:13).

title: The Shield of Faith
summary: Never before in the history of the world has the need for faith in God been greater.

title: Statistical Report, 1999
summary: Brothers and sisters, at the direction of the First Presidency the following statistical report represents the membership growth and status of the Church for the year ending 31 December 1999. This information is based on reports that were received prior to general conference.

title: “Thou Shalt Give Heed unto All His Words”
summary: The continued expansion of technology will only bring the messages to us. … [But it is] the challenge of each individual and family … to internalize the messages of the gospel.

title: “How Is It with Us?”
summary: The most important thing every one of us can do is to examine our own commitment and devotion to the Lord Jesus Christ.

title: Faith, Devotion, and Gratitude
summary: I hope that we have grateful hearts for the knowledge that we have and the testimonies we have and for the feelings we have.

title: The Sanctity of Womanhood
summary: Each of us absolutely must help each daughter of God we can to realize what sacred characteristics Father in Heaven has given her.

title: The Power of Self-Mastery
summary: Self-mastery … is the ultimate test of our character.

title: Your Eternal Voyage
summary: Let us consider our callings, let us reflect on our responsibilities, let us determine our duty, and let us follow Jesus Christ our Lord.

title: The Stake President
summary: Stake presidents have been called under the same inspiration under which the General Authorities were called. I pray for these, my beloved brethren, that the Spirit of the Lord will rest upon them.

title: Your Eternal Home
summary: In a very real sense, we are builders of eternal houses. We are apprentices to the trade—not skilled craftsmen. We need divine help if we are to build successfully.

title: Finding a Safe Harbor
summary: In our own storms in life, the Savior is our solace and our sanctuary. If we seek peace, we must come unto Him.

title: Watch Over and Strengthen
summary: The Savior will let you feel the love He feels for those you serve. The call is an invitation to become like Him.

title: My Testimony
summary: Of all the things for which I feel grateful … , one stands out preeminently. That is a living testimony of Jesus Christ.

title: Content with the Things Allotted unto Us
summary: Life’s necessary defining moments come within our allotments. … Our responses are what matter. Sufficient unto each life are the tests thereof!

title: As Doves to Our Windows
summary: May we do as much with the blessings we have been given as [our ancestors] did out of the deprivations so many of them faced. In such abundance may we never “forget the Lord.”

title: The Creation
summary: Grand as it is, planet Earth is part of something even grander—that great plan of God. Simply summarized, the earth was created that families might be.

title: A Time of New Beginnings
summary: Let us take a little time to meditate, to think of what we can do to improve our lives and to become better examples of what a Latter-day Saint should be.

title: Womanhood: The Highest Place of Honor
summary: I promise you dear young sisters that if you live the standards of personal worthiness contained in the Young Women program, great will be your happiness and endless will be your joy.

title: A Great Family in Reverence and Worship
summary: We speak words of testimony concerning God our Eternal Father and His Beloved Son.

title: The Covenant of Baptism: To Be in the Kingdom and of the Kingdom
summary: Our baptism and confirmation is the gateway into His kingdom. When we enter, we covenant to be of His kingdom—forever!

title: The Redemption of the Dead and the Testimony of Jesus
summary: By identifying our ancestors and performing for them the saving ordinances they could not themselves perform, we are testifying of the infinite reach of the Atonement of Jesus Christ.

title: Living by Scriptural Guidance
summary: We all need guidance through life. We obtain it best from the standard works and teachings of the prophets of God.

title: Be a Strong Link
summary: As my eyesight dims somewhat, I think my vision improves—my vision of the long road, my vision of what lies ahead.

title: Pure Testimony
summary: As a special witness of the name of Jesus Christ in all the world, I promise you that if you seek the Lord, you will find Him. Ask, and you shall receive.

title: The Path to Peace and Joy
summary: Are you taking full advantage of the redeeming power of repentance in your life so that you can have greater peace and joy?

title: One by One
summary: Embrace the Savior’s warm invitation to come unto Him, one by one, and be perfected in Him.

title: The Challenge to Become
summary: In contrast to the institutions of the world, which teach us to know something, the gospel of Jesus Christ challenges us to become something.

title: The Tugs and Pulls of the World
summary: Many individuals preoccupied by the cares of the world are not necessarily in transgression. But they certainly are in diversion and thus waste “the days of [their] probation” (2 Ne. 9:27).

title: “Sanctify Yourselves”
summary: The call in every age—and especially our age—is Joshua’s call: “Sanctify yourselves: for to morrow the Lord will do wonders among you.”

title: The Enemy Within
summary: Each of us needs to train ourselves to be bold, disciplined, and loyal men of the priesthood who are prepared with the proper weapons to fight against evil and to win.

title: The Call to Serve
summary: I revere the priesthood of Almighty God. I have witnessed its power. I have seen its strength. I have marveled at the miracles it has wrought.

title: “Great Shall Be the Peace of Thy Children”
summary: In terms of your happiness, in terms of the matters that make you proud or sad, nothing—I repeat, nothing—will have so profound an effect on you as the way your children turn out.

title: A Growing Testimony
summary: As I look back over my life, I recognize one source of singular strength and blessing. It is my testimony and knowledge that Jesus is the Christ.

title: Discipleship
summary: We must create … ongoing and continual processes that draw us closer to the Lord our Savior so that we can be numbered among His disciples.

title: Dedication Day
summary: As an expression of our love for the Lord, could we not rededicate our lives and our homes in a like manner?

title: This Great Millennial Year
summary: This work is possessed of a vitality which has never been evidenced before to such a degree.

title: “Ye Are the Temple of God”
summary: Your body really is the instrument of your mind and the foundation of your character.

title: Now Is the Time
summary: If we do not … willingly teach others of the Restoration of the gospel of Jesus Christ through the Prophet Joseph Smith, who will?

title: Sharing the Gospel
summary: Given the importance of the message, the help offered by the Spirit, the number of the missionaries and the size of the field that is ready to harvest, 300,000 new converts per year is not nearly enough.

title: “Write upon My Heart”
summary: Prayer can provide the shield of protection the parent will want so much for [a child] to have.

title: “An Humble and a Contrite Heart”
summary: If we have drawn nearer to the Savior, with a more firm resolution to follow His teachings and His example, then this conference will have been a wonderful success.

title: Your Greatest Challenge, Mother
summary: I know of no better answer to [the] foul practices that confront our young people than the teachings of a mother, given in love with an unmistakable warning.

title: The Work Goes On
summary: Let us be good people. Let us be friendly people. Let us be neighborly people. Let us be what members of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints ought to be.

title: First Things First
summary: Do the best you can while on earth to have an ideal family. To help you do that, ponder and apply the principles in the proclamation on the family.

title: “Witnesses unto Me”
summary: For those who find it difficult to initiate missionary conversations—and many do—the Church’s newly produced pass-along cards are a lovely, effortless way to let others know some of your basic beliefs and how they may learn more.

title: Compassion
summary: We have no way of knowing when our privilege to extend a helping hand will unfold before us.

title: Statistical Report, 2000
summary: Brothers and sisters, for the information of the members of the Church, the First Presidency has issued the following statistical report concerning the membership growth and standing of the Church as of December 31, 2000. These statistics are based on reports available prior to the conference.

title: “The Touch of the Master’s Hand”
summary: We all make mistakes. … It is then in our nature to feel guilt and humiliation and suffering, which we alone cannot cure. That is when the healing power of the Atonement will help.

title: Couple Missionaries: A Time to Serve
summary: It is proper for a mature sister or couple to let their priesthood leaders know that they are willing and able to serve a mission. I urge you to do so.

title: Personal Preparation for Temple Blessings
summary: Those who enter the temple are also to bear the attribute of holiness. … We can acquire holiness only by enduring and persistent personal effort.

title: Building a Community of Saints
summary: In any community of Saints, we all work to serve each other in the best way we know how. Our work has a higher purpose because it is work to bless others and to build the kingdom of God.

title: “Watch with Me”
summary: As you watch over His sheep, your love for Him will grow. And that will increase your confidence and your courage.

title: “Them That Honour Me I Will Honour”
summary: Honor four sacred principles in your lives: reverence for Deity; respecting and honoring family relationships; reverence for and obedience to the ordinances and covenants of the holy priesthood; respect for yourself as a son of God.

title: To the Rescue
summary: Brethren, the world is in need of your help. There are feet to steady, hands to grasp, minds to encourage, hearts to inspire, and souls to save.

title: The Perpetual Education Fund
summary: Where there is widespread poverty among our people, we must do all we can to help them to lift themselves, to establish their lives upon a foundation of self-reliance that can come of training. Education is the key to opportunity.

title: Born Again
summary: The full benefit of forgiveness of sin through the Savior’s Atonement begins with repentance and baptism and then expands upon receiving the Holy Ghost.

title: “Plow in Hope”
summary: By utilizing the Atonement, we access the gifts of the Holy Ghost, which “filleth with hope and perfect love” (Moro. 8:26).

title: “His Word Ye Shall Receive”
summary: It is no small thing, my brothers and sisters, to have a prophet of God in our midst. Great and wonderful are the blessings that come into our lives as we listen to the word of the Lord given to us through him.

title: The Miracle of Faith
summary: Faith is the basis of testimony. Faith underlies loyalty to the Church. Faith represents sacrifice, gladly given in moving forward the work of the Lord.

title: Gratitude and Service
summary: May you have a burning feeling in your heart. May you feel as I do on this day that this work is true and that it is meant for us to help bring about the eternal plan of salvation and exaltation.

title: The Law of the Fast
summary: Fasting, coupled with mighty prayer, is powerful. It can fill our minds with the revelations of the Spirit. It can strengthen us against times of temptation.

title: Focus and Priorities
summary: Available information wisely used is far more valuable than multiplied information allowed to lie fallow.

title: Good-bye for Another Season
summary: These conferences are held … to strengthen our testimonies of this work, to fortify us against temptation and sin, to lift our sights, to receive instruction.

title: How Can I Become the Woman of Whom I Dream?
summary: You are daughters of the Almighty. Limitless is your potential. Magnificent is your future, if you will take control of it.

title: Living in the Fulness of Times
summary: Notwithstanding the afflictions about us, notwithstanding the sordid things we see almost everywhere, notwithstanding the conflict that sweeps across the world, we can be better.

title: Sharing the Gospel
summary: The most effective missionaries, member and full-time, always act out of love. … If we lack this love for others, we should pray for it.

title: Prayer
summary: With … faith, we will be able to pray for what we want and appreciate whatever we get. Only with that faith will we pray with the diligence God requires.

title: The Atonement: Our Greatest Hope
summary: Our salvation depends on believing in and accepting the Atonement. Such acceptance requires a continual effort to understand it more fully.

title: Faith of Our Prophets
summary: What we need is the faith of Brigham Young and the faith of Gordon B. Hinckley and the faith of people who are our prophets and leaders.

title: One Step after Another
summary: We don’t have to be perfect today. We don’t have to be better than someone else. All we have to do is to be the very best we can.

title: “Like a Watered Garden”
summary: We should pay [tithes and offerings] as a personal expression of love to a generous and merciful Father in Heaven.

title: Doctrine of Inclusion
summary: If we are truly disciples of the Lord Jesus Christ, we will reach out with love and understanding to all of our neighbors at all times.

title: Fulfilling Our Duty to God
summary: I promise you that your achievement of the Duty to God Award will provide you with a living testimony that will sustain you throughout your life.

title: “Some Great Thing”
summary: May we all be faithful in doing the day-to-day, ordinary things that prove our worthiness, for they will lead us to and qualify us for great things.

title: Duty Calls
summary: All of us have a solemn duty to honor the priesthood and labor to bring many precious souls unto the Lord.

title: Reaching Down to Lift Another
summary: Let us open our hearts, let us reach down and lift up, let us open our purses, let us show a greater love for our fellowmen.

title: Now Is the Time
summary: May we live so that when that final summons is heard, we may have no serious regrets, no unfinished business.

title: The Book of Mormon: Another Testament of Jesus Christ
summary: The Book of Mormon: Another Testament of Jesus Christ has the nourishing power to heal starving spirits of the world.

title: “Set in Order Thy House”
summary: Our family is the focus of our greatest work and joy in this life; so will it be throughout all eternity.

title: The Times in Which We Live
summary: Our safety lies in repentance. Our strength comes of obedience to the commandments of God.

title: The Returned Missionary
summary: What we need is a royal army of returned missionaries reenlisted into service.

title: The Seventh Commandment: A Shield
summary: The keeping of the seventh commandment is such a vital shield! By our lowering or losing that shield, the much-needed blessings of heaven are lost.

title: The Power of a Strong Testimony
summary: Your personal security and happiness depend upon the strength of your testimony, for it will guide your actions in times of trial or uncertainty.

title: “Till We Meet Again”
summary: Our safety lies in the virtue of our lives. Our strength lies in our righteousness. God has made it clear that if we will not forsake Him, He will not forsake us.

title: “Be Thou an Example”
summary: Fill your mind with truth; fill your heart with love; fill your life with service.

title: The Church Goes Forward
summary: No other church to come out of the soil of America has grown so fast nor spread so widely. … It is a phenomenon without precedent.

title: Children
summary: There is in what we believe, there is in what we teach counsel, commandments, even warnings that we are to protect, to love, to care for, and to “teach [children] to walk in the ways of truth.”

title: “Follow Me”
summary: Those who, in faith, leave their nets and follow the Savior will experience happiness beyond their ability to comprehend.

title: Hidden Wedges
summary: Let’s not pass to future generations the grievances, the anger of our time. Let’s remove any hidden wedges that can do nothing but destroy.

title: Statistical Report, 2001
summary: Brothers and sisters, the First Presidency has issued the following report concerning the growth and status of the Church as of December 31, 2001:

title: Full Conversion Brings Happiness
summary: Your happiness now and forever is conditioned on your degree of conversion and the transformation that it brings to your life.

title: True Friends
summary: All of us will be tested. And all of us need true friends to love us, to listen to us, to show us the way, and to testify of truth to us.

title: The Gospel in Our Lives
summary: He has given us His Atonement, His gospel, and His Church, a sacred combination that gives us the assurance of immortality and the opportunity for eternal life.

title: Consecrate Thy Performance
summary: In pondering and pursuing consecration, understandably we tremble inwardly at what may be required. Yet the Lord has said consolingly, “My grace is sufficient for you” (D&C 17:8).

title: Becoming Men in Whom the Spirit of God Is
summary: The Lord is bound by solemn covenant to bless our lives according to our faithfulness. Only He can turn us into men in whom the Spirit of God, namely the Holy Ghost, is.

title: It Can’t Happen to Me
summary: Your future may not hold fame or fortune, but it can be something far more lasting and fulfilling. Remember that what we do in life echoes in eternity.

title: They Pray and They Go
summary: Let us, as a mighty body of priesthood, be doers of the word, and not hearers only. Let us pray, then let us go and do.

title: Personal Worthiness to Exercise the Priesthood
summary: Our behavior in public must be above reproach. Our behavior in private is even more important. It must clear the standard set by the Lord.

title: The Lifeline of Prayer
summary: Each of us has problems that we cannot solve and weaknesses that we cannot conquer without reaching out through prayer to a higher source of strength.

title: The Other Prodigal
summary: No one of us is less treasured or cherished of God than another. I testify that He loves each of us—insecurities, anxieties, self-image, and all.

title: Out of Darkness into His Marvelous Light
summary: The emblems of the Savior’s Atonement remind us that we need not stumble in darkness. We can have His light with us always.

title: We Walk by Faith
summary: We reach toward the unknown, but faith lights the way. If we will cultivate that faith, we shall never walk in darkness.

title: How Firm Our Foundation
summary: The foundation of one’s individual faith, if anchored firmly to eternal truth, allows each of us to reach upward with an eternal perspective.

title: Charity: Perfect and Everlasting Love
summary: As we increasingly think and act like Him, the attributes of the natural man will slip away to be replaced by the heart and the mind of Christ.

title: The Peaceable Things of the Kingdom
summary: Peace—real peace, whole-souled to the very core of your being—comes only in and through faith in the Lord Jesus Christ.

title: We Look to Christ
summary: Like the polar star in the heavens, … there stands the Redeemer of the world, the Son of God, certain and sure as the anchor of our immortal lives.

title: Pathways to Perfection
summary: Exemplify in your lives four tested, specific virtues: an attitude of gratitude, a longing for learning, a devotion to discipline, and a willingness to work.

title: “O That I Were an Angel, and Could Have the Wish of Mine Heart”
summary: I urge you … to utilize the temples of the Church. Go there and carry forward the great and marvelous work which the God of heaven has outlined for us.

title: Called of God
summary: We have been given the great power of the priesthood. It blesses us individually and provides blessings for our family.

title: The Global Church Blessed by the Voice of the Prophets
summary: Let us listen to the prophets of our days as they help us to focus on the things that are central to the Creator’s plan.

title: Encircled in the Arms of His Love
summary: Perplexing things will still happen, but, like Nephi, we can still know that God loves us, a … fact which can and will sustain us through so much!

title: What’s in It for Me?
summary: Taking up one’s cross and following the Savior means overcoming selfishness; it is a commitment to serve others.

title: Were There Not Ten Cleansed?
summary: If we’re ever going to show gratitude properly to our Heavenly Father, we should do it with all of our heart, might, mind, and strength.

title: Tithing: A Test of Faith with Eternal Blessings
summary: Pay your tithing. Unlock the windows of heaven. You will be abundantly blessed for your obedience and faithfulness to the Lord’s laws and commandments.

title: Called to Serve
summary: To raise our families and serve faithfully in the Church, all without running faster than we have strength, require wisdom, judgment, divine help—and inevitably some sacrifice.

title: “Blessed Are the Peacemakers”
summary: Peace is a prime priority that pleads for our pursuit.

title: The Stake Patriarch
summary: The Lord has a special interest in the patriarch, who holds a unique position in the Church.

title: I Believe I Can, I Knew I Could
summary: While we are not all equal in experience, aptitude, and strength, … we will all be accountable for the use of the gifts and opportunities given to us.

title: Peace, Be Still
summary: His words in holy writ are sufficient: “Be still, and know that I am God.”

title: To Men of the Priesthood
summary: You men who hold this precious priesthood, bind it to your very souls. Be worthy of it at all times and in all circumstances.

title: Models to Follow
summary: All of us living in the world today need points of reference, even models to follow.

title: I’ll Go Where You Want Me to Go

title: Rise to Your Call
summary: The Lord will guide you by revelation just as He called you. You must ask in faith for revelation to know what you are to do.

title: The Marvelous Foundation of Our Faith
summary: God be thanked for His marvelous bestowal of testimony, authority, and doctrine associated with this, the restored Church of Jesus Christ.

title: Shall He Find Faith on the Earth?
summary: Only when our faith is aligned with the will of our Heavenly Father will we be empowered to receive the blessings we seek.

title: To Be Free of Heavy Burdens
summary: You must trust that the Savior has given His life so that you can make the required changes in your life—changes that will bring peace.

title: Each a Better Person

title: You Are All Heaven Sent
summary: Your role as sisters is special and unique in the Lord’s work. You are the nurturers and the caregivers.

title: The Condition of the Church
summary: The gospel of Jesus Christ is the way of peace. To the extent we follow it and incorporate it in our lives … will we be blessed and prospered.

summary: We should pray in accord with the will of our Heavenly Father. He wants to test us, to strengthen us, and to help us achieve our full potential.

title: Faith through Tribulation Brings Peace and Joy
summary: However dark conditions may seem in this world today, whatever the storms we are facing personally, … joy can be ours now.

title: In Search of Treasure
summary: Learn from the past, prepare for the future, live in the present.

summary: Brothers and sisters, the First Presidency has issued the following report concerning the growth and status of the Church as of December 31, 2002:

title: The Unspeakable Gift
summary: If [we] would open [our] hearts to the refining influence of this unspeakable gift of the Holy Ghost, a glorious new spiritual dimension would come to light.

title: A Child and a Disciple
summary: The Lord trusts His true disciples. He sends prepared people to His prepared servants.

title: The Essential Role of Member Missionary Work
summary: We must prepare ourselves to assist the missionaries in finding those of our Heavenly Father’s children who will embrace the message of the Restoration.

title: The Importance of the Family
summary: May it be our resolve this year to build a gospel-centered home, a safe harbor from the storms of the adversary.

title: Growing into the Priesthood
summary: Priesthood is the power and authority delegated to man by our Heavenly Father. The authority and majesty of it are beyond our comprehension.

title: The Devil’s Throat
summary: Please help us push back the world. We must stand against the wind. Sometimes we must be unpopular and simply say, “This is not right.”

title: Stand in Your Appointed Place
summary: May we reach out and rescue those who have fallen by the wayside, that not one precious soul will be lost.

title: Loyalty
summary: Be loyal to the best that is in you. Be faithful and true to the covenants that are associated with the priesthood of God.

title: Dear Are the Sheep That Have Wandered

title: Care for the Life of the Soul
summary: Truly converted disciples, though still imperfect, will pursue “the life of the soul” on any day, in any decade, amid any decadence and destruction.

title: Did I Tell You … ?
summary: In the eternal scheme of things, the most crucial and fulfilling thing you will do is to build a holy home and rear a strong family in love.

summary: Faith in God and in His guidance through the Holy Spirit will sustain you in an increasingly more challenging world.

summary: I hope that the Lord’s people may be at peace one with another during times of trouble, regardless of what loyalties they may have to different governments or parties.

title: The Golden Years
summary: Value the old folks for what they are, not just what they can do.

title: A Prayer for the Children
summary: As parents we can hold life together … with love and faith, passed on to the next generation, one child at a time.

title: Give Thanks in All Things
summary: When we give thanks in all things, we see hardships and adversities in the context of the purpose of life.

title: Benediction
summary: I offer a plea that each of us will seek to live closer to the Lord and to commune with Him more frequently and with increased faith.

title: Steadfast in Our Covenants

title: The Virtues of Righteous Daughters of God
summary: I encourage you to strengthen the virtues you have already acquired and resolve to develop many others.

title: You Are a Child of God
summary: My dear young friends, my beloved boys and girls, I am so grateful to be with you when you celebrate Primary’s 125th birthday.

title: The State of the Church

title: Let Our Voices Be Heard
summary: Let us speak out and encourage a more uplifting, inspiring, and acceptable media.

title: Lord, I Believe; Help Thou Mine Unbelief
summary: Sustaining faith can be the ultimate comfort in life. All of us must find our own testimonies.

title: “The Standard of Truth Has Been Erected”
summary: However out of step we may seem, however much the standards are belittled, however much others yield, we will not yield, we cannot yield.

summary: Follow the example of Joseph Smith and the pattern of the Restoration. Turn to the scriptures. Kneel in prayer. Ask in faith. Listen to the Holy Ghost.

title: Repentance and Change

title: Realize Your Full Potential

title: Personal Priesthood Responsibility

title: The Phenomenon That Is You
summary: Begin to unlock the knowledge of who you really are by learning more about your forebears.

title: Bring Him Home
summary: We can, with the Lord’s help, reach out and rescue those for whom we have responsibility.

title: The Grandeur of God

title: Three Choices

summary: God continues to reveal His will to mankind, as He has in all periods of time when He has had authorized servants upon the earth.

summary: Thank you for being the kind of people you are and doing the things you do. May the blessings of heaven rest upon you.

title: The Church Grows Stronger
summary: There is much more yet to be done, but what has been accomplished is truly phenomenal.

title: How Great the Wisdom and the Love

title: Preparation for the Second Coming

summary: Plead with God in the name of Christ to write the gospel in your mind that you may have understanding and in your heart that you may love to do His will.

title: In the Strength of the Lord
summary: We need strength beyond ourselves to keep the commandments in whatever circumstance life brings to us.

title: Your Personal Influence
summary: As we follow that Man of Galilee—even the Lord Jesus Christ—our personal influence will be felt for good wherever we are, whatever our callings.

title: “Abide in Me”

title: Choices
summary: Tomorrow’s blessings and opportunities depend on the choices we make today.

summary: May we heed the voice of the prophets, who, from the beginning of time, have warned us about the importance of fathers in the home.

summary: What a glorious season it has been and now is. A new day has come in the work of the Almighty.

summary: If we could truly understand the Atonement of the Lord Jesus Christ, we would realize how precious is one son or daughter of God.

summary: No matter how evil the world becomes, our families can be at peace. If we do what’s right, we will be guided and protected.

summary: As you continue to center your mind and heart in [the Lord], He will help you have a rich and full life no matter what happens in the world around you.

title: Concluding Remarks
summary: May our testimonies of the great foundation principles of this work … shine forth from our lives and our actions.

title: All Things Shall Work Together for Your Good
summary: As we search, pray, and believe, we will recognize miracles in our lives and become miracle workers in the lives of others.

title: Stay on the High Road
summary: Pray for the strength to walk the high road, which at times may be lonely but which will lead to peace and happiness and joy supernal.

title: Condition of the Church

title: Prophets, Seers, and Revelators

title: Peace of Conscience and Peace of Mind

title: Where Do I Make My Stand?

title: What Is a Quorum?

title: Pure Testimony

title: Choose You This Day
summary: The choices we make determine our destiny.

title: Finding Faith in the Lord Jesus Christ
summary: Only faith in the Lord Jesus Christ and His Atonement can bring us peace, hope, and understanding.

title: The Opportunity to Testify
summary: With … tender feelings of gratitude for all who have influenced my life in past years, I commit myself to the future.

title: In the Strength of the Lord
summary: In the strength of the Lord we can do and endure and overcome all things.

title: Senior Missionaries and the Gospel
summary: I express gratitude for our senior missionaries. They are young in spirit, wise, and willing to work.

title: The Women in Our Lives
summary: How thankful I am, how thankful we all must be, for the women in our lives.

title: The Least of These
summary: Let no one underestimate the power of faith in the ordinary Latter-day Saints.

title: Remember the Teachings of Your Father
summary: The Book of Mormon can and does change lives.

title: Press On
summary: There is one thing the Lord expects of us no matter our difficulties and sorrows: He expects us to press on.

title: Closing Remarks
summary: I would hope that we might go to the house of the Lord a little more frequently.

title: If Ye Are Prepared Ye Shall Not Fear
summary: We do live in turbulent times. Often the future is unknown; therefore, it behooves us to prepare for uncertainties.

title: Opening Remarks
summary: Our burden in going forward is tremendous. But our opportunity is glorious.

title: The Book of Mormon: Another Testament of Jesus Christ—Plain and Precious Things
summary: The Book of Mormon is an endless treasure of wisdom and inspiration, of counsel and correction.

title: Now Is the Time to Prepare
summary: Now is the time to prepare to meet God. Tomorrow may be too late.

title: Constant Truths for Changing Times
summary: We, as members of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints, must stand up to the dangers which surround us and our families.

title: The Virtue of Kindness
summary: Kindness is the essence of a celestial life. Kindness is how a Christlike person treats others.

title: The Power of Preach My Gospel
summary: I encourage you to find out how this extraordinary resource can help in your missionary efforts.

summary: I count Joseph Smith among those whose testimony of Christ helped me to develop my own testimony of the Savior.

summary: The Lord needs to know on whom He can rely.

summary: Perseverance is demonstrated by those who keep going when the going gets tough, who don’t give up even when others say, “It can’t be done.”

summary: The performance of one’s duty brings a sense of happiness and peace.

summary: I encourage our Saints all over the world, wherever possible, to strive to stand more often in holy places.

summary: We need more hardworking, testimony-enriched missionaries in order to reach more of our Heavenly Father’s children.

title: Hearts Bound Together
summary: When you were baptized, your ancestors looked down on you with hope. … They rejoiced to see one of their descendants make a covenant to find them.

summary: On the solid foundation of the Prophet Joseph’s divine calling and the revelations of God, which came through him, we go forward.

summary: Honest seekers of truth are finding answers to their questions—they are finding the Lord through His restored Church.

summary: I testify that the tender mercies of the Lord are available to all of us and that the Redeemer of Israel is eager to bestow such gifts upon us.

summary: Surely the Lord is blessing us as a people, and we must reach out to bless His needy wherever they may be.

summary: You and I can not only survive but prevail, as did Moroni, in our efforts to stand for truth in perilous times.

summary: You can share your testimony in many ways—by the words you speak, by the example you set, by the manner in which you live your life.

summary: The growth of the Church from its infancy to its present stature is phenomenal, and we have only scratched the surface.

summary: The Lord wants us to be made over—but in His image, not in the image of the world, by receiving His image in our countenances.

summary: We are faced with a choice. We can trust in our own strength, or we can journey to higher ground and come unto Christ.

summary: A sacred light comes to our eyes and countenances when we have a personal bond with our loving Heavenly Father and His Son.

title: Priesthood Authority in the Family and the Church
summary: There are many similarities and some differences in the way priesthood authority functions in the family and in the Church.

summary: Be a woman of Christ. Cherish your esteemed place in the sight of God. He needs you. This Church needs you. The world needs you.

title: What Matters Most Is What Lasts Longest
summary: As your leaders, we call upon members of the Church everywhere to put family first and to identify specific ways to strengthen their individual families.

summary: You and I, today and always, are to bear witness of Jesus Christ and declare the message of the Restoration. … Missionary work is a manifestation of our spiritual identity and heritage.

title: Called and Chosen
summary: Those called, sustained, and set apart are entitled to our sustaining support.

title: Do Your Duty—That Is Best
summary: The priesthood is not really so much a gift as it is a commission to serve, a privilege to lift, and an opportunity to bless the lives of others.

title: If Ye Are Prepared Ye Shall Not Fear
summary: We can so live that we can call upon the Lord for His protection and guidance. … We cannot expect His help if we are unwilling to keep His commandments.

title: The Prophet Joseph Smith: Teacher by Example
summary: May we incorporate into our own lives the divine principles which [Joseph Smith] so beautifully taught—by example—that we, ourselves, might live more completely the gospel of Jesus Christ.

title: On Zion’s Hill
summary: Every soul who willingly affiliates with The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints and seeks to abide by its principles and ordinances is standing “on Zion’s hill.”

title: Truth Restored
summary: The Father’s plan of salvation and happiness … will help you overcome every challenge in life.

title: Forgiveness
summary: Somehow forgiveness, with love and tolerance, accomplishes miracles that can happen in no other way.

title: Jesus Christ—the Master Healer
summary: Faith, repentance, baptism, a testimony, and enduring conversion lead to the healing power of the Lord.

title: Preparations for the Restoration and the Second Coming: “My Hand Shall Be over Thee”
summary: [The Lord’s] hand has been over the work of the Restoration from before the foundation of this world and will continue until His Second Coming.

summary: People are most receptive to our influence when they feel that we truly love them, and not only because we have a calling to fulfill.

title: Christlike Attributes—the Wind beneath Our Wings
summary: Living according to the basic gospel principles will bring power, strength, and spiritual self-reliance into the lives of all Latter-day Saints.

summary: God, our Eternal Father, lives. … Jesus is the Christ, the Redeemer of mankind. They have restored Their work in this last and final dispensation through the instrumentality of the Prophet Joseph.

title: Instruments in the Hands of God
summary: Your influence for good is incalculable and indescribable.

title: To Act for Ourselves: The Gift and Blessings of Agency
summary: Agency used righteously allows light to dispel the darkness and enables us to live with joy and happiness.

title: As a Child
summary: Our natures must be changed to become as a child to gain the strength we must have to be safe in the times of moral peril.

title: True to the Faith
summary: Let us resolve here and now to follow that straight path which leads home to the Father of us all.

title: Statistical Report, 2005
summary: Brothers and sisters, the First Presidency has issued the following report concerning the growth and status of the Church as of December 31, 2005:

title: “I Will Remember Your Sins No More”
summary: Through the Father’s redeeming plan, those who may stumble and fall “are not cast off forever.”

title: That We May Always Have His Spirit to Be with Us
summary: We should endeavor to discern when we “withdraw [ourselves] from the Spirit of the Lord” … [and] attend to and learn from the choices and influences that separate us from the Holy Spirit.

title: Your Mission Will Change Everything
summary: Come and be part of the greatest generation of missionaries the world has ever known.

title: Nurturing Marriage
summary: Marriages would be happier if nurtured more carefully.

title: As Now We Take the Sacrament
summary: Partaking of the sacrament provides us with a sacred moment in a holy place.

title: See the End from the Beginning
summary: If you trust the Lord and obey Him, … He will help you achieve the great potential He sees in you.

title: Our Rising Generation
summary: Our rising generation is worthy of our best efforts to support and strengthen them in their journey to adulthood.

title: Repentance, a Blessing of Membership
summary: Repentance … is not a harsh principle. … It is kind and merciful.

title: A Royal Priesthood
summary: While holding the priesthood brings great blessings, the priesthood also carries with it great obligations.

title: Our Sacred Priesthood Trust
summary: The priesthood is not really so much a gift as it is a commission to serve, a privilege to lift, and an opportunity to bless the lives of others.

title: The Need for Greater Kindness
summary: Why do any of us have to be so mean and unkind to others? Why can’t all of us reach out in friendship to everyone about us?

title: The Restoration of All Things
summary: We believe The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints is a restoration of the original Church established by Jesus Christ.

title: Broken Things to Mend
summary: When He says to the poor in spirit, “Come unto me,” He means He knows the way out and He knows the way up.

title: All Men Everywhere
summary: Again and again the Book of Mormon teaches that the gospel of Jesus Christ is universal in its promise and effect.

title: Seek Ye the Kingdom of God
summary: I hope that all of you will remember that on this Sabbath day you heard me bear my witness that this is God’s holy work.

title: Creating a Gospel-Sharing Home
summary: Creating a gospel-sharing home is the easiest and most effective way that we can share the gospel.

title: Now Is the Time to Serve a Mission!
summary: Exciting fields of labor the world over allow the inspiration of the Lord to call young men and women and devoted couples to challenging assignments.

title: The Abundant Life
summary: The abundant life is within our reach if only we will drink deeply of living water, fill our hearts with love, and create of our lives a masterpiece.

title: Until Again We Meet
summary: May we remember and constantly express in our lives the counsel we have received.

title: “I Am the Light Which Ye Shall Hold Up”
summary: Each of our [Christlike] deeds may share only a pinpoint of light, but added together they begin to make a significant difference.

title: Your Light—a Standard to All Nations
summary: I see the light shining in your faces. That light comes from the Lord, and as you radiate that light, it will bless you and many others.

title: We Bear Testimony to the World
summary: The Lord is richly blessing His Church, and our duty is to do all we can to move it forward.

title: He Heals the Heavy Laden
summary: The healing power of the Lord Jesus Christ … is available for every affliction in mortality.

title: The Power of Patience
summary: Patience may well be thought of as a gateway virtue, contributing to the growth and strength of its fellow virtues of forgiveness, tolerance, and faith.

title: O Be Wise
summary: May we focus on the simple ways we can serve in the kingdom of God, always striving to change lives, including our own.

title: Discipleship
summary: One of the greatest blessings of life and eternity is to be counted as one of the devoted disciples of the Lord Jesus Christ.

title: Holy Scriptures: The Power of God unto Our Salvation
summary: Sacred records bear testimony of the Savior and lead us to Him.

title: Sunday Will Come
summary: Because of the life and eternal sacrifice of the Savior of the world, we will be reunited with those we have cherished.

title: The Power of a Personal Testimony
summary: Our firm personal testimony will motivate us to change ourselves and then bless the world.

title: The Atonement Can Secure Your Peace and Happiness
summary: True, enduring happiness, with the accompanying strength, courage, and capacity to overcome the greatest difficulties, will come as you center your life in Jesus Christ.

title: A Priesthood Quorum
summary: The strength of a quorum comes in large measure from how completely its members are united in righteousness.

title: Let Us Be Men
summary: We who hold the priesthood of God … must arise from the dust of self-indulgence and be men!

title: Spiritual Nutrients
summary: We need to increase our spiritual nutrients—nutrients that come from the knowledge of the fulness of the gospel and the powers of the holy priesthood.

title: True to Our Priesthood Trust
summary: It is in doing—not just dreaming—that lives are blessed, others are guided, and souls are saved.

title: Rise Up, O Men of God
summary: With this priesthood comes a great obligation to be worthy of it.

title: How Firm a Foundation
summary: We can fortify our foundations of faith, our testimonies of truth, so that we will not falter, we will not fail.

title: The Plan of Salvation
summary: We are not left alone to wander through mortality without knowing of the master plan which the Lord has designed for His children.

title: The Gathering of Scattered Israel
summary: We help to gather the elect of the Lord on both sides of the veil.

title: The Faith to Move Mountains
summary: Increased faith is what we most need. Without it, the work would stagnate. With it, no one can stop its progress.

summary: We speak of the Church as our refuge, our defense. There is safety and protection in the Church.

title: And Nothing Shall Offend Them
summary: Through the strengthening power of the Atonement of Jesus Christ, you and I can be blessed to avoid and triumph over offense.

title: Prophets in the Land Again
summary: It is no trivial matter for this Church to declare to the world prophecy, seership, and revelation, but we do declare it.

summary: We leave with you our love and our blessing. May the Spirit of the Lord dwell in your homes.

title: In the Arms of His Love
summary: This is the greatest women’s organization in all the world. It is a God-given creation.

summary: Brothers and sisters, the First Presidency has issued the following report concerning the growth and activity of the Church as of December 31, 2006.

title: Using the Supernal Gift of Prayer
summary: Prayer is a supernal gift of our Father in Heaven to every soul.

title: The Tongue of Angels
summary: Our words, like our deeds, should be filled with faith and hope and charity.

title: Ye Must Be Born Again

title: A Tabernacle in the Wilderness
summary: This has been a unique and wonderful place of assembly.

summary: Spiritual rebirth originates with faith in Jesus Christ, by whose grace we are changed.

summary: Meaningful prayer requires both holy communication and consecrated work.

summary: There is no role in life more essential and more eternal than that of motherhood.

title: Walk in the Light
summary: You make choices every day and almost every hour that keep you walking in the light or moving away toward darkness.

title: Let Him Do It with Simplicity

title: To Learn, to Do, to Be

summary: This is God’s work, and God’s work will not be frustrated. But there is still much to be done.

summary: The lessons of the past … prepare us to face the challenges of the future.

summary: We serve our fellowmen because that is what we believe God wants us to do.

title: Preserving the Heart’s Mighty Change
summary: To endure to the end, we need to be eager to please God and worship Him with fervor.

summary: If we heed His words and live the commandments, we will survive this time of permissiveness and wickedness.

summary: I believe it is by divine design that the role of motherhood emphasizes the nurturing and teaching of the next generation.

summary: We have this priesthood power, and we should all be prepared to use it properly.

summary: Let us consider our callings, let us reflect on our responsibilities, and let us follow Jesus Christ.

title: “You Are My Hands”
summary: As disciples of Jesus Christ, our Master, we are called to support and heal rather than condemn.

title: He Lives! All Glory to His Name!
summary: Our understanding of and faith in the Atonement of Jesus Christ will provide strength and capacity needed for a successful life.

summary: We rejoice in all the Savior has done for us. He has made it possible for each of us to gain our salvation and exaltation.

summary: The empty tomb that first Easter morning was the answer to Job’s question, “If a man die, shall he live again?”

summary: Our inborn yearnings for family connections are fulfilled when we are linked to our ancestors through sacred ordinances of the temple.

title: Our Duty to God: The Mission of Parents and Leaders to the Rising Generation
summary: It is our imperative duty to help youth understand and believe the gospel in a deeply personal way.

summary: A stronger personal faith in Jesus Christ will prepare [your children] for the challenges they will most surely face.

title: A Word at Closing
summary: The lighthouse of the Lord sends forth signals readily recognized and never failing.

title: Never, Never, Never Give Up!

title: Your Happily Ever After

title: As We Meet Together Again
summary: Missionary service is a priesthood duty—an obligation the Lord expects of us who have been given so very much.

title: Temple Mirrors of Eternity: A Testimony of Family
summary: An eternal perspective of gospel conversion and temple covenants can help us see rich blessings in each generation of our forever families.

summary: As you choose not to be offended or ashamed, you will feel His love and approval. You will know that you are becoming more like Him.

summary: A consistent, righteous life produces an inner power and strength that can be permanently resistant to the eroding influence of sin and transgression.

title: Be Thou an Example of the Believers
summary: Whether full-time missionaries or members, we should all be good examples of the believers in Jesus Christ.

summary: Our Savior is the Prince of Peace, the Great Healer, the only One who can truly cleanse us from the sting of sin.

summary: Pride is a switch that turns off priesthood power. Humility is a switch that turns it on.

title: Serve with the Spirit
summary: Let us do whatever is required to qualify for the Holy Ghost as our companion.

summary: Each of us has come to this earth with all the tools necessary to make correct choices.

title: Trust in God, Then Go and Do
summary: You show your trust in Him when you listen with the intent to learn and repent and then you go and do whatever He asks.

title: Cleansing the Inner Vessel
summary: Nowhere are the generosity and the kindness and mercy of God more manifest than in repentance.

title: Be an Example of the Believers
summary: I would like to invite you to “be … an example of the believers … in faith [and] in purity.”

title: The Divine Gift of Gratitude
summary: A grateful heart … comes through expressing gratitude to our Heavenly Father for His blessings and to those around us for all that they bring into our lives.

title: The Priesthood of Aaron
summary: The priesthood you bear is a special gift, for the giver is the Lord Himself. Use it, magnify it, and live worthy of it.

title: Receive the Holy Ghost

title: O That Cunning Plan of the Evil One
summary: There is hope for the addicted, and this hope comes through the Atonement of the Lord Jesus Christ.

title: Till We Meet Again
summary: Endure to the end we must, for our goal is eternal life in the presence of our Father in Heaven.

title: Charity Never Faileth
summary: Rather than being judgmental and critical of each other, may we have the pure love of Christ for our fellow travelers in this journey through life.

summary: Thank you for your faith and devotion to the gospel, for the love and care you show to one another, and for the service you provide.

title: The Sabbath and the Sacrament
summary: Let your family be filled with love as you honor the Sabbath all day long and experience its spiritual blessings throughout the week.

title: The Atonement Covers All Pain
summary: Our great personal challenge in mortality is to become “a saint through the atonement of Christ.”

title: LDS Women Are Incredible!
summary: Much of what we accomplish in the Church is due to the selfless service of women.

title: Opportunities to Do Good
summary: The Lord’s way to help those in temporal need requires people who out of love have consecrated themselves and what they have to God and to His work.

title: Statistical Report, 2010

title: Guided by the Holy Spirit
summary: Every one of us can be guided by the spirit of revelation and the gift of the Holy Ghost.

title: Face the Future with Faith
summary: Truth, covenants, and ordinances enable us to overcome fear and face the future with faith!

title: Desire
summary: To achieve our eternal destiny, we will desire and work for the qualities required to become an eternal being.

title: Finding Joy through Loving Service
summary: May we show our love and appreciation for the Savior’s atoning sacrifice through our simple, compassionate acts of service.

title: Preparing the World for the Second Coming
summary: Your mission will be a sacred opportunity to bring others to Christ and help prepare for the Second Coming of the Savior.

title: Your Potential, Your Privilege
summary: As you read the scriptures and listen to the words of the prophets with all your heart and mind, the Lord will tell you how to live up to your priesthood privileges.

summary: If you will be diligent and obedient in the priesthood, treasures of spiritual knowledge will be poured out upon you.

title: Priesthood Power
summary: May we be worthy recipients of the divine power of the priesthood we bear. May it bless our lives and may we use it to bless the lives of others.

summary: Those who diligently seek to learn of Christ eventually will come to know Him.

title: The Spirit of Revelation
summary: The spirit of revelation is real—and can and does function in our individual lives and in the Church.

title: The Holy Temple—a Beacon to the World
summary: The all-important and crowning blessings of membership in the Church are those blessings which we receive in the temples of God.

summary: The temple sealing has greater meaning as life unfolds. It will help you draw ever closer together and find greater joy and fulfillment.

summary: If we teach by the Spirit and you listen by the Spirit, some one of us will touch on your circumstance.

summary: None of us can conceive the full import of what Christ did for us in Gethsemane, but I am grateful every day of my life for His atoning sacrifice.

summary: Benevolence can bring joy and unity to your home, your class, your ward, and your school.
