summary: Testimony requires the nurturing by the prayer of faith, the hungering for the word of God in the scriptures, and the obedience to the truth.

title: The Power of Scripture
summary: Scriptures are like packets of light that illuminate our minds and give place to guidance and inspiration from on high.

title: As We Meet Again
summary: It is my prayer that we may be filled with the Spirit of the Lord as we listen to the messages today and tomorrow and learn those things the Lord would have us know.

title: Counsel to Youth
summary: Despite the opposition, trials, and temptations, you need not fail or fear.

title: You Matter to Him
summary: The Lord uses a scale very different from the world’s to weigh the worth of a soul.

title: The Hearts of the Children Shall Turn
summary: I invite the young people of the Church to learn about and experience the Spirit of Elijah.

title: Children
summary: I testify of the great blessing of children and of the happiness they will bring us in this life and in the eternities.

title: It Is Better to Look Up
summary: If we, like President Monson, exercise our faith and look to God for help, we will not be overwhelmed with the burdens of life.

title: The Divine Gift of Repentance
summary: Only through repentance do we gain access to the atoning grace of Jesus Christ.

title: Perfect Love Casteth Out Fear
summary: If you will respond to the invitation to share your beliefs and feelings about the restored gospel of Jesus Christ, a spirit of love and a spirit of courage will be your constant companion.

title: We Are All Enlisted
summary: From every man, young and old, who bears the priesthood, I ask for a stronger and more devoted voice, … a voice for good, a voice for the gospel, a voice for God.

title: Providing in the Lord’s Way
summary: The welfare principles of the Church are not simply good ideas; they are revealed truths from God—they are His way of helping the needy.

title: Preparation in the Priesthood: “I Need Your Help”
summary: Don’t worry about how inexperienced you are or think you are, but think about what, with the Lord’s help, you can become.

title: Dare to Stand Alone
summary: May we ever be courageous and prepared to stand for what we believe.

title: A Witness
summary: The Book of Mormon is the best guide to learn how well we are doing and how to do better.

title: Waiting upon the Lord: Thy Will Be Done
summary: The purpose of our life on earth is to grow, develop, and be strengthened through our own experiences.

title: The Importance of a Name
summary: Let us develop the habit … of making it clear that The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints is the name by which the Lord Himself has directed that we be known.

title: Stand in Holy Places
summary: Communication with our Father in Heaven—including our prayers to Him and His inspiration to us—is necessary in order for us to weather the storms and trials of life.

title: Covenants
summary: When we realize that we are children of the covenant, we know who we are and what God expects of us.

title: Teachings of Jesus
summary: Jesus Christ is the Only Begotten and Beloved Son of God. … He is our Savior from sin and death. This is the most important knowledge on earth.

title: The Songs They Could Not Sing
summary: While we do not know all the answers, we do know important principles that allow us to face tragedies with faith and confidence.

title: Until We Meet Again
summary: May the spirit we have felt here be and abide with us as we go about those things which occupy us each day.

title: Forget Me Not
summary: It is my prayer and blessing that you will never forget that you are truly precious daughters in God’s kingdom.

title: As We Gather Once Again
summary: Our Heavenly Father is mindful of each of us and our needs. May we be filled with His Spirit as we partake of the proceedings of this conference.

title: And a Little Child Shall Lead Them
summary: Husbands and wives should understand that their first calling—from which they will never be released—is to one another and then to their children.

title: Sacrifice
summary: Our lives of service and sacrifice are the most appropriate expressions of our commitment to serve the Master and our fellowmen.

title: Mountains to Climb
summary: If we have faith in Jesus Christ, the hardest as well as the easiest times in life can be a blessing.

title: Statistical Report, 2011
summary: For the information of the members of the Church, the First Presidency has issued the following statistical report concerning the growth and status of the Church as of December 31, 2011.

title: The Laborers in the Vineyard
summary: Please listen to the prompting of the Holy Spirit telling you right now, this very moment, that you should accept the atoning gift of the Lord Jesus Christ.

title: Coming to Ourselves: The Sacrament, the Temple, and Sacrifice in Service
summary: We become converted and spiritually self-reliant as we prayerfully live our covenants.

title: Abide in the Lord’s Territory!
summary: Our daily question must be, “Do my actions place me in the Lord’s or in the enemy’s territory?”

title: In Tune with the Music of Faith
summary: God loves all His children. He wants all of them to return to Him. He desires everyone to be in tune with the sacred music of faith.

title: How to Obtain Revelation and Inspiration for Your Personal Life
summary: Why does the Lord want us to pray to Him and to ask? Because that is how revelation is received.

title: The Powers of Heaven
summary: Priesthood holders young and old need both authority and power—the necessary permission and the spiritual capacity to represent God in the work of salvation.

title: The Why of Priesthood Service
summary: Understanding the why of the gospel and the why of the priesthood will help us to see the divine purpose of all of this.

title: Families under Covenant
summary: There is nothing that has come or will come into your family as important as the sealing blessings.

title: Willing and Worthy to Serve
summary: Miracles are everywhere to be found when the priesthood is understood, its power is honored and used properly, and faith is exerted.

title: The Merciful Obtain Mercy
summary: When our hearts are filled with the love of God, we become “kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving.”

title: Thanks Be to God
summary: How much better it would be if all could be more aware of God’s providence and love and express that gratitude to Him.

title: Special Lessons
summary: It is my hope and prayer that we will continue to bear nobly our burdens and to reach out to those among us who are suffering.

title: The Doctrine of Christ
summary: In the Church today, just as anciently, establishing the doctrine of Christ or correcting doctrinal deviations is a matter of divine revelation.

title: The Race of Life
summary: Where did we come from? Why are we here? Where do we go after this life? No longer need these universal questions remain unanswered.

title: The Power of Deliverance
summary: We can be delivered from the ways of evil and wickedness by turning to the teachings of the holy scriptures.

title: That the Lost May Be Found
summary: As you seek to live the gospel and doctrine of Christ, the Holy Ghost will guide you and your family.

title: Was It Worth It?
summary: The work of naturally and normally sharing the gospel with those we care about and love will be the work and joy of our lives.

title: What Thinks Christ of Me?
summary: As you love Him, trust Him, believe Him, and follow Him, you will feel His love and approval.

title: As We Close This Conference
summary: May you ponder the truths you have heard, and may they help you to become even better than you were when conference began.

title: Seek Learning: You Have a Work to Do
summary: Bless your children and your future home by learning as much as you can now.

title: Believe, Obey, and Endure
summary: Believe that remaining strong and faithful to the truths of the gospel is of utmost importance. I testify that it is!

title: Welcome to Conference
summary: May we listen attentively to the messages … , that we may feel the Spirit of the Lord and gain the knowledge He would desire for us.

title: Can Ye Feel So Now?
summary: Some in the Church believe they can’t answer Alma’s question with a resounding yes. They do not “feel so now.”

title: Ask the Missionaries! They Can Help You!
summary: All missionaries, younger and older, serve with the sole hope of making life better for other people.

title: Of Regrets and Resolutions
summary: The more we devote ourselves to the pursuit of holiness and happiness, the less likely we will be on a path to regrets.

title: Becoming Goodly Parents
summary: There are many ways that goodly parents can access the help and support they need to teach the gospel of Jesus Christ to their children.

title: Be Anxiously Engaged
summary: Great things are brought about and burdens are lightened through the efforts of many hands “anxiously engaged in a good cause.”

title: Trial of Your Faith
summary: Like the intense fire that transforms iron into steel, as we remain faithful during the fiery trial of our faith, we are spiritually refined and strengthened.

title: Protect the Children
summary: None should resist the plea that we unite to increase our concern for the welfare and future of our children—the rising generation.

title: Brethren, We Have Work to Do
summary: As men of the priesthood, we have an essential role to play in society, at home, and in the Church.

title: Be Valiant in Courage, Strength, and Activity
summary: Qualify yourselves as did the 2,000 stripling soldiers by being valiant in courage as worthy priesthood holders.

title: The Joy of the Priesthood
summary: Let us embrace and understand the wonder and privilege of the priesthood. Let us accept and love the responsibilities we are asked to fulfill.

title: Help Them Aim High
summary: With your guidance, those you lead will be able to see, want, and believe they can achieve their full potential for service in God’s kingdom.

title: See Others as They May Become
summary: We must develop the capacity to see men not as they are at present but as they may become.

title: Where Is the Pavilion?
summary: The pavilion that seems to intercept divine aid does not cover God but occasionally covers us. God is never hidden, yet sometimes we are.

title: The Atonement
summary: Wherever our members and missionaries may go, our message is one of faith and hope in the Savior Jesus Christ.

title: The First Great Commandment
summary: We have a life of devoted discipleship to give in demonstrating our love of the Lord.

title: Consider the Blessings
summary: Our Heavenly Father is aware of our needs and will help us as we call upon Him for assistance.

title: Being a More Christian Christian
summary: This is the call of Christ to every Christian today: “Feed my lambs. … Feed my sheep.”

title: The Joy of Redeeming the Dead
summary: “He shall plant in the hearts of the children the promises made to the fathers, and the hearts of the children shall turn to their fathers.”

title: Converted unto the Lord
summary: Knowing that the gospel is true is the essence of a testimony. Consistently being true to the gospel is the essence of conversion.

title: God Be with You Till We Meet Again
summary: As we take the messages of the past two days into our hearts and into our lives, we will be blessed.

title: The Caregiver
summary: You will be strengthened and yet inspired to know the limits and extent of your ability to serve.

title: Welcome to Conference
summary: I urge you to be attentive and receptive to the messages which we will hear. That we may do so is my prayer.

title: These Things I Know
summary: Of all that I have read and taught and learned, the one most precious and sacred truth that I have to offer is my special witness of Jesus Christ.

title: “This Is My Work and Glory”
summary: God has freely given His power to those who accept and honor His priesthood, which leads to the promised blessings of immortality and eternal life.

title: “Come unto Me”
summary: By His words and His example, Christ has shown us how to draw closer to Him.

title: Statistical Report, 2012
summary: Brook P. Hales presents the Church Statistical Report for 2012.

title: For Peace at Home
summary: One of the greatest blessings we can offer to the world is the power of a Christ-centered home where the gospel is taught, covenants are kept, and love abounds.

title: Personal Peace: The Reward of Righteousness
summary: Even with the trials of life, because of the Savior’s Atonement and His grace, righteous living will be rewarded with personal peace.

title: We Believe in Being Chaste
summary: Obedience to the law of chastity will increase our happiness in mortality and make possible our progress in eternity.

title: Catch the Wave
summary: I thank God and His Son, Jesus Christ, for the Restoration and its power to propel a magnificent wave of truth and righteousness across the earth.

title: Stand Strong in Holy Places
summary: Standing obedient and strong on the doctrine of our God, we stand in holy places, for His doctrine is sacred and will not change.

title: Four Titles
summary: I would like to suggest four titles … that may help us recognize our individual roles in God’s eternal plan and our potential as priesthood holders.

title: We Are One
summary: I pray that wherever we are and whatever duties we have in the priesthood of God, we will be united in the cause to bring the gospel to all the world.

title: Come, All Ye Sons of God
summary: May each one of us search the scriptures with diligence, plan his life with purpose, teach the truth with testimony, and serve the Lord with love.

title: The Hope of God’s Light
summary: As we seek to increase our love for God and strive to love our neighbor, the light of the gospel will surround and uplift us.

title: It’s a Miracle
summary: If you’re not a full-time missionary with a missionary badge pinned on your coat, now is the time to paint one on your heart—painted, as Paul said, “not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God.”

title: Obedience to Law Is Liberty
summary: Men and women receive their agency as a gift from God, but their liberty and, in turn, their eternal happiness come from obedience to His laws.

title: Obedience Brings Blessings
summary: A knowledge of truth and the answers to our greatest questions come to us as we are obedient to the commandments of God.

title: “Lord, I Believe”
summary: Honestly acknowledge your questions and your concerns, but first and forever fan the flame of your faith, because all things are possible to them that believe.

title: Followers of Christ
summary: Following Christ is not a casual or occasional practice but a continuous commitment and way of life that applies at all times and in all places.

title: Redemption
summary: Inasmuch as we follow Christ, we seek to participate in and further His redemptive work.

title: Until We Meet Again
summary: I pray that the Lord will bless and keep you, my brothers and sisters. May His promised peace be with you now and always.

title: When You Save a Girl, You Save Generations
summary: Your virtuous lives will bless your ancestors, your families now, and family members yet to come.

title: Your Wonderful Journey Home
summary: As you joyfully use the map your loving Father has provided for your journey, it will lead you to holy places and you will rise to your supernal potential.

title: Welcome to Conference
summary: It is my prayer that we may be filled with the Spirit of the Lord as we listen and learn.

title: General Conference: Strengthening Faith and Testimony
summary: Oh, how we need general conference! Through conferences our faith is fortified and our testimonies deepened.

title: Be Meek and Lowly of Heart
summary: Being meek does not mean weakness, but it does mean behaving with goodness and kindness.

title: The Windows of Heaven
summary: Spiritual and temporal blessings come into our lives as we live the law of tithing.

title: Come, Join with Us
summary: Regardless of your circumstances, your personal history, or the strength of your testimony, there is room for you in this Church.

title: The Key to Spiritual Protection
summary: Peace can be settled in the heart of each who turns to the scriptures and unlocks the promises of protection and redemption.

title: The Moral Force of Women
summary: Your intuition is to do good and to be good, and as you follow the Holy Spirit, your moral authority and influence will grow.

title: Like a Broken Vessel
summary: How do you best respond when mental or emotional challenges confront you or those you love?

title: Put Your Trust in the Lord
summary: Become engaged in doing what you can in sharing the great message of the Restoration of the gospel of Jesus Christ.

title: The Doctrines and Principles Contained in the Articles of Faith
summary: Each article of faith adds unique value to our understanding of the gospel of Jesus Christ.

title: You Can Do It Now!
summary: As long as we are willing to rise up again and continue on the path, … we can learn something from failure and become better and happier.

title: Bind Up Their Wounds
summary: I pray that we may prepare ourselves to give whatever priesthood service the Lord may set before us on our mortal journey.

title: True Shepherds
summary: Home teaching answers many prayers and permits us to see the transformations which can take place in people’s lives.

title: To My Grandchildren
summary: There is one overarching commandment that will help us to meet the challenges and lead to the heart of a happy family life.

title: No Other Gods
summary: Are we serving priorities or gods ahead of the God we profess to worship?

title: Personal Strength through the Atonement of Jesus Christ
summary: Through the Atonement of Jesus Christ, each of us can become clean and the burden of our rebellion will be lifted.

title: “I Will Not Fail Thee, nor Forsake Thee”
summary: Our Heavenly Father … knows that we learn and grow and become stronger as we face and survive the trials through which we must pass.

title: Lamentations of Jeremiah: Beware of Bondage
summary: Our challenge is to avoid bondage of any kind, help the Lord gather His elect, and sacrifice for the rising generation.

title: Power in the Priesthood
summary: A man may open the drapes so the warm sunlight comes into the room, but the man does not own the sun or the light or the warmth it brings.

title: Teaching with the Power and Authority of God
summary: The Lord has provided the way for every worthy Latter-day Saint to teach in the Savior’s way.

title: Decisions for Eternity
summary: The wise use of your freedom to make your own decisions is crucial to your spiritual growth, now and for eternity.

title: Till We Meet Again
summary: May we show increased kindness toward one another, and may we ever be found doing the work of the Lord.

title: We Never Walk Alone
summary: You will one day stand aside and look at your difficult times, and you will realize that He was always there beside you.

title: Welcome to Conference
summary: We are … united in our faith and in our desire to listen to and learn from the messages which will be presented to us.

title: The Cost—and Blessings—of Discipleship
summary: Be strong. Live the gospel faithfully even if others around you don’t live it at all.

title: The Joyful Burden of Discipleship
summary: To sustain our leaders is a privilege; it comes coupled with a personal responsibility to share their burden and to be disciples of the Lord.

title: Spiritual Whirlwinds
summary: Don’t let the whirlwinds drag you down. These are your days—to stand strong as disciples of the Lord Jesus Christ.

title: A Priceless Heritage of Hope
summary: When you choose whether to make or keep a covenant with God, you choose whether you will leave an inheritance of hope to those who might follow your example.

title: Statistical Report, 2013
summary: Secretary to the First Presidency Brook P. Hales reads the statistical report for 2013, including the total number of members.

title: Let Your Faith Show
summary: Day after day, on your path toward your eternal destiny, increase your faith. Proclaim your faith! Let your faith show!

title: “I Have Given You an Example”
summary: The greatest example who ever walked the earth is our Savior, Jesus Christ. … He invites us to follow His perfect example.

title: “If Ye Love Me, Keep My Commandments”
summary: Using our agency to obey means choosing to “do what is right [and letting] the consequence follow.”

title: Roots and Branches
summary: Hastening family history and temple work in our day is essential for the salvation and exaltation of families.

title: The Keys and Authority of the Priesthood
summary: Priesthood keys direct women as well as men, and priesthood ordinances and priesthood authority pertain to women as well as men.

title: Are You Sleeping through the Restoration?
summary: There is too much at stake for us as individuals, as families, and as Christ’s Church to give only a halfhearted effort to this sacred work.

title: The Priesthood Man
summary: You can be a great model, an average one, or a bad model. You may think it doesn’t matter to you, but it does to the Lord.

title: Be Strong and of a Good Courage
summary: Let us—all of us—have the courage to defy the consensus, the courage to stand for principle.

title: Grateful in Any Circumstances
summary: Have we not reason to be filled with gratitude, regardless of the circumstances in which we find ourselves?

title: Following Up
summary: We can all be more consistently involved in missionary work by replacing our fear with real faith.

title: Your Four Minutes
summary: The miracle of the Atonement can make up for imperfections in our performance.

title: Bear Up Their Burdens with Ease
summary: The unique burdens in each of our lives help us to rely upon the merits, mercy, and grace of the Holy Messiah.

title: Love—the Essence of the Gospel
summary: We cannot truly love God if we do not love our fellow travelers on this mortal journey.

title: The Witness
summary: I wish to share with you those truths which are the most worth knowing.

title: Obedience through Our Faithfulness
summary: Obedience is an emblem of our faith in the wisdom and power of the highest authority, even God.

title: The Resurrection of Jesus Christ
summary: Jesus of Nazareth is the resurrected Redeemer, and I testify of all that follows from the fact of His Resurrection.

title: Until We Meet Again
summary: May the Spirit we have felt during these past two days be and abide with us as we go about those things which occupy us each day.

title: Daughters in the Covenant
summary: The path … we must take on our journey back to our Heavenly Father … is marked by sacred covenants with God.

title: Welcome to Conference
summary: As we listen, may our hearts be touched and our faith increased.

title: The Reason for Our Hope
summary: A testimony of the hope of redemption is something which cannot be measured or counted. Jesus Christ is the source of that hope.

title: Free Forever, to Act for Themselves
summary: It is God’s will that we be free men and women enabled to rise to our full potential both temporally and spiritually.

title: Receiving a Testimony of Light and Truth
summary: Your personal testimony of light and truth will not only bless you and your posterity here in mortality, but it will also accompany you throughout all eternity.

title: Loving Others and Living with Differences
summary: As followers of Christ we should live peacefully with others who do not share our values or accept the teachings upon which they are based.

title: Joseph Smith
summary: Jesus Christ chose a holy man, a righteous man, to lead the Restoration of the fulness of His gospel. He chose Joseph Smith.

title: Are We Not All Beggars?
summary: Rich or poor, we are to “do what we can” when others are in need.

title: Finding Lasting Peace and Building Eternal Families
summary: It is the gospel of Jesus Christ that provides the foundation upon which we can find lasting peace and build eternal family units.

title: Choose Wisely
summary: “Refuse the evil, and choose the good” (Isaiah 7:15).

title: “Lord, Is It I?”
summary: We must put aside our pride, see beyond our vanity, and in humility ask, “Lord, is it I?”

title: The Preparatory Priesthood
summary: In priesthood preparation, “show me” counts more than “tell me.”

title: Guided Safely Home
summary: We look heavenward for that unfailing sense of direction, that we might chart and follow a wise and proper course.

title: Continuing Revelation
summary: Human judgment and logical thinking will not be enough to get answers to the questions that matter most in life. We need revelation from God.

title: Sustaining the Prophets
summary: Our sustaining of prophets is a personal commitment that we will do our utmost to uphold their prophetic priorities.

title: Live according to the Words of the Prophets
summary: To be in harmony with heaven’s divine purposes, we sustain the prophet and choose to live according to his words.

title: Eternal Life—to Know Our Heavenly Father and His Son, Jesus Christ
summary: God and Christ are literally a Father and a Son—separate, distinct, individual beings who are wholly unified in Their purpose.

title: Ponder the Path of Thy Feet
summary: As we look to Jesus as our Exemplar and as we follow in His footsteps, we can return safely to our Heavenly Father.

title: Stay in the Boat and Hold On!
summary: If we keep our focus on the Lord, we are promised a blessing beyond comparison.

title: Make the Exercise of Faith Your First Priority
summary: Despite all of the negative challenges we have in life, we must take time to actively exercise our faith.

title: The Book
summary: Family history and temple work should be a regular part of our personal worship.

title: Come and See
summary: The Church of Jesus Christ always has been and always will be a missionary church.

title: Until We Meet Again
summary: May we all ponder the truths we have heard, and may they help us to become even more valiant disciples.

title: Living the Gospel Joyful
summary: Trust in the saving power of Jesus Christ; keep His laws and commandments. In other words—live the gospel joyful.

title: The Comforter
summary: I give my witness that the living Christ sends the Holy Ghost, the Comforter, to those we are pledged to help Him comfort.

title: “Is Not This the Fast That I Have Chosen?”
summary: Your fast offering will do more than help feed and clothe bodies. It will heal and change hearts.

title: The Plan of Happiness
summary: The end of all activity in the Church is to see that a man and a woman with their children are happy at home, sealed for eternity.

title: The Parable of the Sower
summary: It is up to each of us to set the priorities and to do the things that make our soil good and our harvest plentiful.

title: Why Marriage and Family Matter—Everywhere in the World
summary: Family is the center of life and is the key to eternal happiness.

title: Statistical Report, 2014
summary: Brook P. Hales reads the statistical report for 2014.

title: Therefore They Hushed Their Fears
summary: Unlike worldly fear that creates alarm and anxiety, godly fear is a source of peace, assurance, and confidence.

title: Why Marriage, Why Family
summary: A family built on the marriage of a man and woman supplies the best setting for God’s plan to thrive.

title: The Music of the Gospel
summary: The music of the gospel is the joyful spiritual feeling that comes from the Holy Ghost. It brings a change of heart.

title: Latter-day Saints Keep on Trying
summary: As we try, persevere, and help others to do the same, we are true Latter-day Saints.

title: The Lord Is My Light
summary: Our ability to stand firm and true and follow the Savior despite the vicissitudes of life is greatly strengthened by righteous families and Christ-centered unity in our wards and branches.

title: The Greatest Generation of Young Adults
summary: What we need now is the greatest generation of young adults in the history of the Church. We need your whole heart and soul.

title: Yes, We Can and Will Win!
summary: We must hold ever more tightly to our testimony of the gospel of Jesus Christ. Then we will win the daily battles against evil.

title: On Being Genuine
summary: I pray that we will resist the temptation to draw attention to ourselves and, instead, strive for a far greater honor: to become humble, genuine disciples of Jesus Christ.

title: Priesthood and Personal Prayer
summary: God can grant us power in the priesthood for whatever circumstance we may be in. It simply requires that we ask in humility.

title: The Priesthood—a Sacred Gift
summary: Each of us has been entrusted with one of the most precious gifts ever bestowed upon mankind.

title: Blessings of the Temple
summary: As we attend the temple, there can come to us a dimension of spirituality and a feeling of peace.

title: Where Justice, Love, and Mercy Meet
summary: Jesus Christ suffered, died, and rose from death in order that He could lift us to eternal life.

title: The Gift of Grace
summary: Today and forevermore God’s grace is available to all whose hearts are broken and whose spirits are contrite.

title: Preserving Agency, Protecting Religious Freedom
summary: The faithful use of our agency depends upon our having religious freedom.

title: Thy Kingdom Come
summary: The thought of His coming stirs my soul. It will be breathtaking! The scope and grandeur, the vastness and magnificence, will exceed anything mortal eyes have ever seen or experienced.

title: The Sabbath Is a Delight
summary: How can you ensure that your behavior on the Sabbath will lead to joy and rejoicing?

title: Here to Serve a Righteous Cause
summary: May we choose to serve a righteous cause as valiant emissaries of our Lord Jesus Christ.

title: A Summer with Great-Aunt Rose
summary: As you walk along your own bright path of discipleship, I pray that faith will fortify every footstep along your way.

title: It Works Wonderfully!
summary: I pray that we will focus on “the simplicity that is in Christ” and allow His grace to lift and carry us.

title: God Is at the Helm
summary: Commandments and covenants are priceless truths and doctrines found in the Old Ship Zion, where God is at the helm.

title: Shipshape and Bristol Fashion: Be Temple Worthy—in Good Times and Bad Times
summary: Adherence to sacred gospel principles will allow us to be temple worthy, enable us to find happiness in this life, and lead us back to our heavenly home.

title: Meeting the Challenges of Today’s World
summary: The choices you make—mission, education, marriage, career, and service in the Church—will shape your eternal destiny.

title: Behold Thy Mother
summary: No love in mortality comes closer to approximating the pure love of Jesus Christ than the selfless love a devoted mother has for her child.

title: Strengthened by the Atonement of Jesus Christ
summary: Because of His Atonement, the Savior has the power to succor—to help—every mortal pain and affliction.

title: Faith Is Not by Chance, but by Choice
summary: Faith in Jesus Christ is a gift from heaven that comes as we choose to believe and as we seek it and hold on to it.

title: Be Not Afraid, Only Believe
summary: When we choose to believe, exercise faith unto repentance, and follow our Savior, Jesus Christ, we open our spiritual eyes to splendors we can scarcely imagine.

title: You Are Not Alone in the Work
summary: As you move from one priesthood service to another, you will see the Lord is in the work with you.

title: Keep the Commandments
summary: He who created us and who loves us perfectly knows just how we need to live our lives in order to obtain the greatest happiness possible.

title: Be an Example and a Light
summary: As we follow the example of the Savior, ours will be the opportunity to be a light in the lives of others.

title: I Stand All Amazed
summary: My testimony of Jesus Christ has been built from many special experiences in which I have come to know His great love for each one of us.

title: Plain and Precious Truths
summary: Heavenly Father’s generous compensation for living in perilous times is that we also live in the fulness of times.

title: Through God’s Eyes
summary: To effectively serve others, we must see them through a parent’s eyes, through Heavenly Father’s eyes.

title: A Plea to My Sisters
summary: We need your strength, your conversion, your conviction, your ability to lead, your wisdom, and your voices.

title: The Holy Ghost as Your Companion
summary: We can, if we live worthy of it, have the blessing of the Spirit to be with us, not only now and then but always.

title: Why the Church
summary: It is worth pausing to consider why Jesus Christ chooses to use a church, His Church, to carry out His and His Father’s work.

title: “Chosen to Bear Testimony of My Name”
summary: It is wonderful to have older men of great spiritual maturity and judgment serving in the senior leadership positions of the restored Church of Jesus Christ.

title: Trust in That Spirit Which Leadeth to Do Good
summary: We grow closer to the Savior as we, out of pure love, serve others for Him.

title: Where Two or Three Are Gathered
summary: If you listen with the Spirit, you will find your heart softened, your faith strengthened, and your capacity to love the Lord increased.

title: Where Are the Keys and Authority of the Priesthood?

title: Highly Favored of the Lord
summary: Times of affliction and disappointment do not change the watchful eye of the Lord as He favorably looks upon us, blessing us.

title: Do Justly, Love Mercy, and Walk Humbly with God
summary: To do justly means acting honorably. We act honorably with God by walking humbly with Him. We act honorably with others by loving mercy.

title: Waiting on the Lord
summary: Faith means trusting God in good times and bad, even if that includes some suffering until we see His arm revealed in our behalf.

title: A New Normal
summary: I invite you to turn your heart, mind, and soul increasingly to our Heavenly Father and His Son, Jesus Christ.

title: Welcome Message
summary: Welcome to general conference and to the privilege of hearing the voice of the Lord.

title: God among Us
summary: God is among us—and is personally involved in our lives and actively guiding His children.

title: Hearts Knit Together
summary: As you extend yourself with kindness, care, and compassion, I promise that you will lift up arms that hang down and will heal hearts.

title: Room in the Inn
summary: In this Easter season, Jesus Christ invites us to become, like Him, a good Samaritan, to make His Inn (His Church) a refuge for all.

title: I Love to See the Temple
summary: It is in the temple that we can receive the assurance of loving family connections that will continue after death and last for eternity.

title: Not as the World Giveth
summary: The instruments we need to create a brighter day and grow an economy of genuine goodness are abundantly provided for in the gospel of Jesus Christ.

title: Infuriating Unfairness
summary: Jesus Christ both understands unfairness and has the power to provide a remedy.

title: The Personal Journey of a Child of God
summary: As covenant children of God, we love, honor, nurture, safeguard, and welcome those spirits who are coming from the premortal world.

title: Hope in Christ
summary: We long to help all who feel alone or feel they don’t belong. Let me mention, in particular, those who are currently single.

title: Bishops—Shepherds over the Lord’s Flock
summary: The bishop has a paramount role in serving as a shepherd to guide the rising generation to Jesus Christ.

title: Bless in His Name
summary: The purpose for our receiving the priesthood is to allow us to bless people for the Lord, doing so in His name.

title: What Has Our Savior Done for Us?
summary: Jesus Christ has done everything that is essential for our journey through mortality toward the destiny outlined in the plan of our Heavenly Father.

title: What We Are Learning and Will Never Forget
summary: If you look at your life prayerfully, I believe you will see many ways in which the Lord has been guiding you through this time of hardship.

title: Jesus Christ: The Caregiver of Our Soul
summary: As we genuinely repent of our sins, we allow the atoning sacrifice of Christ to become wholly effective in our life.

title: Christ Is Risen; Faith in Him Will Move Mountains
summary: Faith in Jesus Christ is the greatest power available to us in this life. All things are possible to them that believe.

title: Defending Our Divinely Inspired Constitution
summary: Our belief in divine inspiration gives Latter-day Saints a unique responsibility to uphold and defend the United States Constitution and principles of constitutionalism.

title: “Behold! I Am a God of Miracles”
summary: Miracles, signs, and wonders abound among followers of Jesus Christ today, in your lives and in mine.

title: Why the Covenant Path
summary: The difference of the covenant path is uniquely and eternally significant.

title: “The Principles of My Gospel”
summary: A gospel principle is a doctrinally based guideline for the righteous exercise of moral agency.

title: COVID-19 and Temples
summary: Keep your temple covenants and blessings foremost in your minds and hearts. Stay true to the covenants you have made.

title: Pure Truth, Pure Doctrine, and Pure Revelation
summary: Please make this conference a time of feasting on messages from the Lord through His servants.

title: The Greatest Possession
summary: Each of us is to come to Christ with uncompromised commitment to His gospel.

title: The Savior’s Abiding Compassion
summary: The expression of compassion for others is the essence of the gospel of Jesus Christ.

title: The Love of God
summary: Our Father and our Redeemer have blessed us with commandments, and in obeying Their commandments, we feel Their perfect love more fully and more profoundly.

title: The Need for a Church
summary: The scriptures clearly teach the origin and need for a church directed by and with the authority of our Lord, Jesus Christ.

title: With the Power of God in Great Glory
summary: Honoring covenants arms us with righteousness and with the power of God in great glory.

title: The Things of My Soul
summary: What things do you ponder? What things really matter to you? What are the things of your soul?

title: Simply Beautiful—Beautifully Simple
summary: May we keep the gospel simple as we take upon us our divinely appointed responsibilities.

title: “Lovest Thou Me More Than These?”
summary: What things can you do within your own life to show that you love the Lord first?

title: The Faith to Ask and Then to Act
summary: Faith in Jesus Christ is the key to receiving revelations of truth.

title: Daily Restoration
summary: We need an ongoing, daily infusion of heavenly light. We need “times of refreshing.” Times of personal restoration.

title: The Peace of Christ Abolishes Enmity
summary: When love of Christ envelops our lives, we approach disagreements with meekness, patience, and kindness.

title: Personal Peace in Challenging Times
summary: It has never been more important to seek personal peace.

title: The Temple and Your Spiritual Foundation
summary: Whenever any kind of upheaval occurs in your life, the safest place to be spiritually is living inside your temple covenants!

title: Trust Again
summary: Trust in God and each other brings heaven’s blessings.

title: The Name of the Church Is Not Negotiable
summary: When we willingly follow the counsel of the Lord as revealed through His living prophet, especially if it runs counter to our initial thinking, requiring humility and sacrifice, the Lord blesses us with additional spiritual power.

title: Make Time for the Lord
summary: I plead with you today to counter the lure of the world by making time for the Lord in your life—each and every day.

title: Preaching the Gospel of Peace
summary: We have the sacred responsibility to share the power and peace of Jesus Christ with all who will listen.

title: Missionary Service Blessed My Life Forever
summary: I pray that you young men and young women and your parents will see and know how missionary service will forever bless your life.

title: But We Heeded Them Not
summary: Covenants and ordinances point us to and help us always remember our connection with the Lord Jesus Christ as we progress along the covenant path.

title: Following Jesus: Being a Peacemaker
summary: Peacemakers are not passive; they are persuasive in the Savior’s way.

title: Steady in the Storms
summary: When the storms in life come, you can be steady because you are standing on the rock of your faith in Jesus Christ.

title: Fear Not: Believe Only!
summary: Begin your search for happiness by embracing the bounty we have already received from the giver of every good gift.

title: He Is Risen with Healing in His Wings:
summary: Jesus has overcome the abuses of this world to give you power to not only survive but one day, through Him, to overcome and even conquer.

title: We Each Have a Story
summary: Please come find your family, all your generations, and bring them home.

title: Conversion to the Will of God
summary: Our personal conversion includes the responsibility to share the gospel of Jesus Christ with the world.

title: Introductory Message
summary: We honor the daughters of God in this special session by concentrating on their concerns and those of their organizations.

title: Your Divine Nature and Eternal Destiny
summary: I invite you to center your life on Jesus Christ and remember the foundational truths in the Young Women theme.

title: Our Relationship with God
summary: No matter what our mortal experience may entail, we can trust God and find joy in Him.

title: Love, Share, Invite
summary: As we love, share, and invite, we take part in that great and glorious work that prepares the earth for the return of its Messiah.

title: To Heal the World
summary: Wounds and differences can be resolved and even healed when we honor God, the Father of us all, and Jesus Christ, His Son.

title: The Power of Spiritual Momentum
summary: I would like to suggest five specific actions we can take to help us maintain positive spiritual momentum.

title: Divine Love in the Father’s Plan
summary: The purpose of the doctrine and policies of this restored Church is to prepare God’s children for salvation in the celestial kingdom and for exaltation in its highest degree.

title: In Awe of Christ and His Gospel
summary: May the remembrance of what our eyes have seen and our hearts have felt increase our amazement at the Savior’s atoning sacrifice.

title: Our Heartfelt All
summary: If we want the Savior to lift us heavenward, then our commitment to Him and His gospel can’t be casual or occasional.

title: Now Is the Time
summary: Now is the time we can learn. Now is the time we can repent. Now is the time we can bless others.

title: Helping the Poor and Distressed
summary: The Church of Jesus Christ is committed to serving those in need, and it is also committed to cooperating with others in that effort.

title: Jesus Christ Is the Strength of Youth
summary: Put your trust in Jesus Christ. He will lead you the right way. He is your strength.

title: A Framework for Personal Revelation
summary: We need to understand the framework within which the Holy Ghost functions. When we operate within the framework, the Holy Ghost can unleash astonishing insight.

title: This Day
summary: Our living prophet is doing his part to flood the earth with the Book of Mormon. We must follow his lead.

title: What Is True?
summary: God is the source of all truth. The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints embraces all truth that God conveys to His children.

title: Follow Jesus Christ with Footsteps of Faith
summary: Christ can carry us today through difficult times. He did it for the early pioneers, and He will do it now for each one of us.

title: In Partnership with the Lord
summary: The restored gospel of Jesus Christ proclaims the principle of full partnership between woman and man, both in mortal life and in the eternities.

title: The Doctrine of Belonging
summary: The doctrine of belonging comes down to this for each of us: I am one with Christ in the gospel covenant.

title: Drawing Closer to the Savior
summary: Seeking to know and love the Savior, we separate ourselves from the world through covenants with God, being distinct, uncommon, and special, without isolating ourselves from others who believe differently.

title: Lifted Up upon the Cross
summary: To be a follower of Jesus Christ, one must sometimes carry a burden and go where sacrifice is required and suffering is inevitable.

title: Happy and Forever
summary: True, enduring joy and eternity with those we love are the very essence of God’s plan of happiness.

title: Put On Thy Strength, O Zion
summary: Each of us should evaluate our temporal and spiritual priorities sincerely and prayerfully.

title: Overcome the World and Find Rest
summary: Find rest from the intensity, uncertainty, and anguish of this world by overcoming the world through your covenants with God.

title: Legacy of Encouragement
summary: I encourage you to continue striving to qualify to return to Heavenly Father and Jesus Christ.

title: Nourishing and Bearing Your Testimony
summary: I invite you to seek opportunities to bear your testimony in word and in deed.

title: Be True to God and His Work
summary: We all need to seek our own testimony of Jesus Christ, bridle our passions, repent of our sins, and be true to God and His work.

title: Focus on the Temple
summary: I promise that increased time in the temple will bless your life in ways nothing else can.

title: The Greatest Easter Story Ever Told
summary: Look at the Book of Mormon in a new light and consider the profound witness it bears of the reality of the risen Christ.

title: Just Keep Going—with Faith
summary: Exercising faith in our Savior, Jesus Christ, helps us overcome discouragement no matter what obstacles we encounter.

title: Ministering
summary: Let us reach out and care as our Savior would, especially to those whom we are privileged by love and assignment to minister.

title: Safely Gathered Home
summary: We are in a unique position to gather Israel on both sides of the veil as never before under the Father’s plan.

title: Finding Personal Peace
summary: I pray that you may find peace, help many others to find it, and pass it along.

title: Accessing God’s Power through Covenants
summary: As you walk the covenant path, from baptism to the temple and throughout life, I promise you power to go against the natural worldly flow.

title: Jesus Christ Is the Strength of Parents
summary: Help your children build faith in Jesus Christ, love His gospel and His Church, and prepare for a lifetime of righteous choices.

title: One in Christ
summary: It is only in and through our individual loyalty to and love of Jesus Christ that we can hope to be one.

title: Followers of the Prince of Peace
summary: As we strive to develop attributes like the Savior’s, we can become instruments of His peace in the world.

title: My Mind Caught Hold upon This Thought of Jesus Christ
summary: As you continue to attentively catch hold of the thought of Jesus Christ, I promise you not only heavenly guidance but heavenly power.

title: Peacemakers Needed
summary: You have your agency to choose contention or reconciliation. I urge you to choose to be a peacemaker, now and always.

title: The Teachings of Jesus Christ
summary: We are given the scriptures to direct our lives. My message today consists of a selection of the words of our Savior—what He said.

title: Remember What Matters Most
summary: What matters most is our relationships with Heavenly Father and His Beloved Son, our families, and our neighbors, and allowing the Spirit to guide us.

title: Hosanna to the Most High God
summary: Jesus Christ’s triumphant entry into Jerusalem and the events of the week that followed exemplify doctrine we can apply in our lives today.

title: “Abide in Me, and I in You; Therefore Walk with Me”
summary: The Savior’s promise to abide in us is true and available to every covenant-keeping member of His restored Church.

title: In the Path of Their Duty
summary: You who today are pressing forward in the path of your duty are the strength of the Savior’s restored Church.

title: The Sealing Power
summary: The sealing power makes individual salvation and family exaltation universally available to the children of God.

title: Kingdoms of Glory
summary: We have a loving Heavenly Father who will see that we receive every blessing and every advantage that our own desires and choices allow.

title: Tithing: Opening the Windows of Heaven
summary: The windows of heaven open in many ways. Trust in the Lord’s timing; the blessings always come.

title: Promptings of the Spirit
summary: The constant companionship of the Holy Ghost is one of the greatest spiritual gifts Latter-day Saints enjoy.

title: How Great Will Be Your Joy
summary: I now invite you to take your know-how, coupled with your time-honored testimonies, and go on a mission.

title: Brothers and Sisters in Christ
summary: May we enjoy more the spiritual kinship that exists between us and value the different attributes and varied gifts we all have.

title: Praise to the Man
summary: How abundantly blessed we are to know all that we know because we have Joseph Smith, the prophet of this last dispensation of time.

title: Be Peaceable Followers of Christ
summary: I testify that “peaceable followers of Christ” will find personal peace in this life and a glorious heavenly reunion.

title: The Prodigal and the Road That Leads Home
summary: Though choices may have taken you far from the Savior and His Church, the Master Healer stands at the road that leads home, welcoming you.

title: Our Constant Companion
summary: You and I have the opportunity to have the Holy Ghost as our constant companion.

title: Jesus Christ Is the Treasure
summary: Focus on Jesus Christ. He is our Savior and Redeemer, the “mark” to whom we should look, and our greatest treasure.

title: Love Is Spoken Here
summary: May we each learn to speak and hear His love here, in our hearts and homes, and in our gospel callings, activities, ministering, and service.

title: Motions of a Hidden Fire
summary: God hears every prayer we offer and responds to each of them according to the path He has outlined for our perfection.

title: Covenant Confidence through Jesus Christ
summary: When we enter the Lord’s house, we embark on a sacred journey of learning to become higher and holier disciples of Christ.

title: All Will Be Well Because of Temple Covenants
summary: There is nothing more important than honoring the covenants you have made or may make in the temple.

title: “Be Still, and Know That I Am God”
summary: We can be still and know that God is our Heavenly Father, we are His children, and Jesus Christ is our Savior.

title: All Things for Our Good
summary: In time and eternity, the purpose of Creation and the nature of God Himself are to bring all things together for our good.

title: In Support of the Rising Generation
summary: It is relationships in the lives of the youth that have the greatest influence on their choices.

title: Be One with Christ
summary: We are united by our love of and faith in Jesus Christ and His Atonement. The essence of truly belonging is to be one with Christ.

title: Words Matter
summary: Words set a tone. They voice our thoughts, feelings, and experiences, for good or bad.

title: The Powerful, Virtuous Cycle of the Doctrine of Christ
summary: I invite you to live the doctrine of Christ repeatedly, iteratively, and intentionally and help others on their way.

title: God’s Intent Is to Bring You Home
summary: Everything about the Father’s plan for His beloved children is designed to bring everyone home.

title: The Testimony of Jesus
summary: My invitation is to act now to secure your place as one who is valiant in the testimony of Jesus.

title: Bridging the Two Great Commandments
summary: Our ability to follow Jesus Christ depends upon our strength and power to live the first and second commandments with balance and equal devotion.

title: Temples, Houses of the Lord Dotting the Earth
summary: As you come worthily and prayerfully to His holy house, you will be armed with His power.

title: Rejoice in the Gift of Priesthood Keys
summary: Priesthood keys govern how the priesthood of God may be used to bring about the Lord’s purposes and bless all who accept the restored gospel.

title: The Triumph of Hope
summary: Hope is a living gift, a gift that grows as we increase our faith in Jesus Christ.

title: “This Is My Gospel”—“This Is My Church”
summary: This is the Savior’s gospel, and this is His Church (see 3 Nephi 27:21; Mosiah 26:22; 27:13). The combination of the two is powerful and transformative.

title: Following Christ
summary: As followers of Christ, we teach and testify of Jesus Christ, our Perfect Role Model. So let us follow Him by forgoing contention.

title: Burying Our Weapons of Rebellion
summary: May we bury—very, very deep—any element of rebellion against God in our lives and replace it with a willing heart and a willing mind.

title: Aligning Our Will with His
summary: Following the Lord’s will in our life will enable us to find the most precious pearl in the world—the kingdom of heaven.

title: Holiness to the Lord in Everyday Life
summary: Holiness to the Lord makes daily living sacred. It draws us closer and happier to the Lord and each other.

title: In the Space of Not Many Years
summary: If we are not faithful and obedient, we can transform the God-given blessing of prosperity into a prideful curse that diverts and distracts us.

title: “I Am He”
summary: Christ’s charity—evident in complete loyalty to divine will—persisted and continues to persist.

title: Mortality Works!
summary: Despite the challenges we all face, our loving Heavenly Father has designed the plan of happiness such that we are not destined to fail.

title: Days Never to Be Forgotten
summary: Upcoming moments will provide members of the Church everywhere with increased opportunities to share the glad tidings of the gospel of Jesus Christ.

title: Simple Is the Doctrine of Jesus Christ
summary: I bear witness of the sacred work of teaching Heavenly Father’s children the simple doctrine of Jesus Christ.

title: Nourish the Roots, and the Branches Will Grow
summary: The branches of your testimony will draw strength from your deepening faith in Heavenly Father and His Beloved Son.

title: “Behold I Am the Light Which Ye Shall Hold Up”
summary: We hold up the Lord’s light when we hold fast to our covenants and when we support our living prophet.

title: Sacred Scriptures—the Foundations of Faith
summary: We cannot underestimate the significance of sacred scriptures both in conversions and in remaining faithful in the gospel.

title: As a Little Child
summary: I testify that babies and children and youth are images of the kingdom of God flourishing on earth in all of its strength and beauty.

title: Right Before Our Eyes
summary: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints is growing in members and families, missions and missionaries, meetinghouses and temples.

title: The Atonement of Jesus Christ Provides the Ultimate Rescue
summary: As we turn to Jesus Christ, the Savior of the world, He rescues us from the storms of life through His Atonement.

title: “Draw Near unto Me”
summary: Jesus Christ loves each of us. He offers us the opportunity to draw closer to Him.

title: Cherishing Life
summary: Life is a most precious part of our Father’s perfect plan, and by His decree we cherish and preserve life.

title: Personal Preparation to Meet the Savior
summary: Follow the Savior’s teachings. His instructions are neither mysterious nor complex. When we follow them, we do not need to fear or be anxious.

title: “By This All Will Know That You Are My Disciples”
summary: Our love for God and His children is a powerful testimony to the world that this is truly the Savior’s Church.

title: And We Talk of Christ
summary: We are followers of Jesus Christ, and we seek to both receive and share His light.

title: The Plan of Mercy
summary: The Lord is merciful and our Heavenly Father’s plan of salvation is truly a plan of mercy.

title: Worship
summary: What does worshipping God mean for you and me?

title: The Times of Restitution of All Things
summary: The most important and glorious “good news” is the message that the Lord Jesus Christ has restored His gospel and Church in the latter days.

title: Eternity’s Great Gifts: Jesus Christ’s Atonement, Resurrection, Restoration
summary: We find in Easter in Jesus Christ peace, becoming, and belonging—that which is enduringly real and joyful, happy and forever.

title: Divine Helps for Mortality
summary: Our Heavenly Father’s plan provides helps to guide us through our mortal journeys.

title: Reverence for Sacred Things
summary: Reverence for the sacred fosters genuine gratitude, expands true happiness, leads our minds to revelation, and brings greater joy to our lives.

title: Receive His Gift
summary: You are a beloved daughter of God, you are a cherished son of God, and He has gifted you His perfect, holy Son.

title: Confidence in the Presence of God
summary: As we diligently seek to have charity and virtue fill our lives, our confidence in approaching God will increase.

title: Introduction
summary: We now go forward with this semiannual general conference, proceeding as planned and with speakers and music assigned by President Nelson after months of preparation.

title: Blessed Are the Peacemakers
summary: Peacemaking still begins in the most basic place—in our hearts. Then in homes and families.

title: Do Your Part with All Your Heart
summary: Trust the Savior and engage, patiently and diligently, in doing your part with all your heart.

title: The Family Proclamation—Words from God
summary: The proclamation has a divine origin, so we must treat it with the reverence deserving words from God.

title: The Eternal Gift of Testimony
summary: Every son or daughter of God can gain a deeper, firmer, and surer knowledge for themselves.

title: No One Sits Alone
summary: Living the gospel of Jesus Christ includes making room for all in His restored Church.

title: The Lord Is Hastening His Work
summary: As the Lord hastens His work, we should love, nurture, and serve those who accept His gospel.

title: Jesus Christ and Your New Beginning
summary: All of us can have a new beginning through, and because of, Jesus Christ. Even you.

title: The Atoning Love of Jesus Christ
summary: Healing and forgiveness are each found in their fulness in the atoning love of Jesus Christ.

title: And Now I See
summary: The impact of the Book of Mormon in my life is no less miraculous than was the application of spit and dirt placed on the blind man’s eyes.

title: Adorned with the Virtue of Temperance
summary: I extend an earnest invitation to all of us to adorn our minds and hearts with the Christlike virtue of temperance.

title: Look to God and Live
summary: It is only by looking to God that individuals, families, and even nations can flourish.

title: Proved and Strengthened in Christ
summary: Proving moments are not evidence that the Lord has abandoned you. Rather, they are evidence that He loves you enough to refine and strengthen you.

title: They Are Their Own Judges
summary: If we have exercised faith in Jesus Christ, made and kept covenants with God, and repented of our sins, the judgment bar will be pleasing.

title: Forsake Not Your Own Mercy
summary: You have immediate access to divine help and healing despite your human flaws.

title: Taking on the Name of Jesus Christ
summary: The more we identify with and remember Jesus Christ, the more we want to be like Him.

title: The Family-Centered Gospel of Jesus Christ
summary: Our doctrine and our belief in eternal families strengthen and bond us.

title: Solemn Assembly
summary: In a solemn assembly, President Christofferson presents the names of the First Presidency and Quorum of the Twelve Apostles for sustaining votes.

title: Ministering—“That Ye Love One Another; as I Have Loved You”
summary: Ministering is truly loving and caring for others as the Savior would. It is a way of being; it is the way of our Savior, Jesus Christ.

title: Follow the Prophet; He Knows the Way
summary: When we follow the teachings and examples of prophets, seers, and revelators, we are following our Savior, Jesus Christ.

title: Tithing—Putting God First
summary: I am certain that the payment of tithes and offerings will enhance our spiritual capacity as we put God first.

title: Sustaining of General Authorities, Area Seventies, and General Officers
summary: President Christofferson presents the General Authorities, Area Seventies, and General Officers of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints for a sustaining vote.

title: Church Auditing Department Report, 2025
summary: To the First Presidency of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints

title: Christ—Author and Finisher of Our Faith
summary: Becoming a lifelong disciple of Christ is a process, the sum of multiple small, daily, personal and spiritual events.

title: “I Will Give Away All My Sins to Know Thee”
summary: We can come to know the true God the Father and gain eternal life through His Son, Jesus Christ, for the power is in us.

title: Jesus Christ Is Not Our Burden; He Is Our Relief
summary: May we together continue to walk with Jesus Christ, even in our most difficult moments.

title: Jesus Christ Is the Way
summary: As we bind ourselves to Him through covenant and follow His living prophet, we walk the one path that leads us safely home.

title: He Knows You by Name
summary: The most eternity-shaping name we can receive is the sacred name of Jesus Christ.

title: Best Days and Worst Days
summary: Because of Jesus Christ, no matter how bad things are right now, your best days are ahead.

title: I Feel My Savior’s Love
summary: It is my prayer that each of us will feel our Savior’s love as we partake of the sacrament.

title: Choose Jesus Christ as Your Guide
summary: I need Jesus Christ to be my guide through life’s journey amid its spiritual land mines. All of us do.

title: The Joy of a Covenant Relationship with God
summary: Wherever you are now or whatever you are going through in your life, you can feel God’s infinite love manifested through His Son, Jesus Christ.

title: A Peculiar Treasure
summary: The Lord declared that His people would be a peculiar treasure unto Him if they would obey His voice and keep His covenant.

title: Remember, Remember
summary: Every promise of redemption, every hope of resurrection, and every assurance of eternal life flows through Jesus Christ.

title: I Glory in My Jesus
summary: Nephi and Ammon inspire me to deepen my relationship with Jesus Christ and to rejoice in the many ways we can glory in Him.

title: “Here Am I, Send Me”
summary: Children all over the world are offering what they have to bring God’s love to their families, church, friends, and communities.

title: Come unto Christ—Together
summary: I invite you to make a commitment and choose to come unto Christ—together. Eternity shall be your reward.

title: Be Slow to Anger
summary: My brothers and sisters, I am in complete harmony with every word that Elder [Marion G.] Romney has just said to us, and with that which was said in the meeting this morning by our prophet leader, and by those who followed him in speaking the truth of the everlasting gospel.

title: “Thus Saith the Lord”
summary: About a month ago I was sent by the First Presidency to hold a series of Church conferences in South America. Frankly, I didn’t know quite what to expect of that land. I had thought of South America as a rather primitive jungle area. I expected the people to be a little backward, perhaps in need of education and training in the ways of modern civilization. When I saw those countries and their people, I couldn’t have been more astonished.

title: Sustaining of General Authorities and Officers
summary: You will notice that two chairs are vacant—Elder Hugh B. Brown of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles, and Elder Alma Sonne, an Assistant to the Twelve. Upon the advice of their doctors, they have remained at home. We have been hopeful that they might be able to attend at least one of the sessions before the conference ends. Other than that, all of the General Authorities are in attendance.

title: Thou Shalt Not
summary: Some time ago, I heard a great businessman give an interesting success formula. He said that when contemplating any accomplishment, one of the first steps to be taken was to definitely decide on those things that should be done under any circumstances. That is, if one were going into business, there are certain dishonest practices and improper procedures that should definitely and permanently be ruled out of bounds in advance. Or in planning a happy marriage, there are infidelities and disloyalties that must be entertained. When one has definitely eliminated those things that he will do, then he can concentrate all of his time and energy on the things that he do.

title: A New Health Missionary Program
summary: This is an awesome responsibility, my dear brethren, and with fear and trembling I stand before you, praying that I may be blessed with a portion of that Spirit which has inspired those who have preceded me.

title: “Turn Heavenward Our Eyes”
summary: In the Book of Job we read where the Lord spoke to Job and said:

title: What Is a Teacher?
summary: We have been taught well in this great conference, my brothers and sisters, and I have been thinking a great deal about teaching and great teachers. Last evening, Elder Marion D. Hanks brought to our attention the situation concerning his departed cousin, a Brother [Ivan] Frame, who had a deep impact on humanity. He mentioned that one of the great tributes paid at his funeral was that every boy should have a Brother Frame in his life.

title: The Nobility of Man in Choosing Good over Evil
summary: I feel honored this morning, my brothers and sisters, to be in the presence of the First Presidency of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints and my fellow associates in the cause of Jesus the Master. This vast congregation is also most humbling. I have sought the inspiration of the Spirit in the few thoughts I have prepared.

title: The Living Christ
summary: I sincerely hope and pray that I may have the Spirit of the Lord to be with me as I speak to you this afternoon.

title: Our Witness to the World
summary: Good morning, my brothers and sisters and friends. I deem it a privilege and a great honor to greet you in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ. We meet in his name. It is because of him that we are here, and everything we do in this life, if it is really worthwhile, comes through him.

title: Am I My Brother’s Keeper?
summary: After Adam had been created by the Lord in his image and after his own likeness, the Lord pointed out that it was not good for man to be alone. So Eve was created and given to Adam to be his wife, his companion and helpmeet.

title: Missionary Training Begins Early
summary: In my mind’s eye I see Russell Nelson, Jr., newly arrived from his home in heaven and staring up into the eyes of his father as though to say to him (as Joseph Smith said to Newel K. Whitney), “You prayed me here; now what do you want of me?”

title: To Serve the Master
summary: My dear brothers and sisters: I don’t know why I should be shaking as I am. I am among friends. I know that no one loves me more than these brethren who are sitting before you, and I love them. Nearly all of them have visited our home and stayed with us and left their blessings.

title: A Second Witness for Christ
summary: During the few minutes that I am before you, I would like to address my remarks to those who are not of this faith; and since we are all the children of God, I would like to refer to you as my brothers and sisters.

title: “And Always Remember Him”
summary: On the evening of his betrayal, Jesus met with his Twelve Apostles in an upper room guest chamber in Jerusalem to observe the annual Feast of the Passover.

title: Success—A Journey or a Destination?
summary: Following the theme that was so masterfully developed this morning by President Tanner, I would like to present a few thoughts on success.

title: The Constant Exercise of Our Faith
summary: I am sure that as grandfathers and fathers, you rejoice with me in these children who have rendered the singing at this session of the conference. They are wonderful. Being a grandfather of 14, I have learned to love grandchildren.

title: Share the Unsearchable Riches of Christ
summary: My dear brothers and sisters: It is a great privilege to be here with you on this occasion. I bring you greetings from the greatest group of missionaries in the world. It is a marvelous thing to labor among them and to feel the strength of the Lord as he works through them and the Saints to bring the gospel of Jesus Christ to his children.

title: Youth’s Opportunity to Serve
summary: My beloved brethren: Last Saturday I was honored to speak to several hundred young men and women graduating seminary students from the high schools in Utah Valley. Under the leadership of a council of their own peers, they had planned a full day’s activity, which included visits to Welfare Square and the Beehive House, a talent assembly, a devotional and testimony meeting, and a lovely dance. To my knowledge, the only adult who took active part was the area supervisor who introduced me. The rest of the adults present were there to give silent support and, by evening, were feeling their age after sharing a day of youthful vitality and enthusiastic activity.

title: Hold Up Your Hands
summary: My brothers and sisters: I appreciate very much this privilege of having some part with you in these great general conferences of the Church. This is the place where we come each six months to be instructed in our duties and built up in our faith. This is where some of the most important business of the Church is transacted. And then twice each year we have this thrilling, exciting experience of holding up our hands and making a personal covenant with the Lord that we will sustain and support those who are placed in authority over us in the Church and that we will also keep all of the Lord’s commandments.

title: The Rock of Revelation
summary: Enoch, the sixth from Adam, was most certainly one of the great prophets of all time, for he walked and talked with the Lord for three hundred years, according to the scriptures. Imagine the understanding that entered his mind, the enlargement of his soul, and the eternal truths that were revealed to him by the Creator of the earth and the heavens.

title: When I Read, I Am There
summary: When I decided to choose a subject for this moment, I discovered I did not have enough words in the English language to properly express my true feelings, but it is the only language I know and so I shall have to use them and hope that the prayer of Brother Burton, which he offered at the beginning, will be applied to me as well as to you.

title: The Witnesses of Christ
summary: In about the year . 30 there came to the banks of the River Jordan a man—young, strong, and rustic in appearance. He began to baptize people, but he was not like others who were baptizing in Jordan; and there were others, for they baptized only to bring people into their particular religious sect.

title: Sustaining of General Authorities and Church Officers
summary: President Tanner then presented the General Authorities, General Officers and General Auxiliary Officers of the Church for the sustaining vote of the conference as follows.

title: A Fortune to Share
summary: In the greatest sermon that was ever preached, the greatest man who ever lived gave what was probably the wisest counsel that has ever been given when he said that we should lay up for ourselves treasures in heaven. And that is probably our most profitable idea.

title: “Which Way to Shore?”
summary: At one of the stake conferences to which I was assigned, a home teacher was invited to be a speaker at the general session on Sunday morning. He began by telling about a man who accidentally fell into the waters of the Niagara River some distance above the falls. As he was carried downstream by the current, he called out repeatedly, “Which way to shore? Which way to shore?” There were people along the banks on both sides of the river who saw and heard this man but they were slow to act. They noticed that he could swim and was keeping himself afloat, so they concluded that he was engaged in some kind of a publicity stunt and gave him no further attention. However, when he reached the point where he was precariously close to the falls some of the people along the banks went into action and tried to get ropes to him to pull him from the water. But they had waited too long and he went over the brink of the falls and was killed. When his body was recovered and identification made, the horizons of those along the banks of the river were pushed back and their understandings improved and increased. Yes, the man could swim, but he could not swim with purpose or direction because he was blind.

title: “The Gospel of Jesus Christ Is the Golden Door”
summary: At a news conference in Mexico City after the area conference, President Marion G. Romney was invited by a newsman to answer a question. The question was this: Do you have a welfare program in your church? And President Romney responded, “Yes, and if you join the Church, you can contribute to it also.”

title: You Shall Receive the Spirit
summary: I deem it a great honor and privilege to greet you in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ. We are met in his name and we act under his direction because this is his church, and we look to him as the only way—the truth and the light. In the words of a great prophet recorded in the Book of Mormon:

title: The Need for Total Commitment
summary: My Church assignments require me to do considerable traveling throughout the world. When I arrive in a city, a stake president or one of his counselors usually meets me at the airport. Although seldom if ever have I met him before, I can invariably find him among the crowd of watchers at the gate and can walk up to him and greet him. He can also recognize me among the crowd of deplaning passengers. A certain amount of publicity is associated with our work as General Authorities. Our pictures appear in various magazines and news articles, so I can explain how he can recognize me from having seen my picture. But how is it that I can so readily recognize him?

title: God’s Way to Eternal Life
summary: The Lord’s thoughts and ways are higher than the thoughts and ways that come from men.

title: That the Scriptures Might Be Fulfilled
summary: One who reads through the books of Matthew and John finds in them not only the account of the life of the Lord Jesus Christ and the story of the establishment of his kingdom on earth, but the evidences that he fulfilled the prophecies concerning the promised Messiah. These two apostles seemed to have been concerned with the fact that the Lord fulfilled the prophecies, as well as doing wonderful and awe-inspiring works before people.

title: The Power of Elijah
summary: My brothers and sisters, that which has transpired here today has my wholehearted approval. To these men who have been appointed of God as prophets, I give my wholehearted support and loyalty.

title: The Family—A Divine Blessing
summary: It is a great privilege to be here today to address you. My heart is filled with wonderful feelings as I contemplate the great blessings we enjoy as a result of the reestablishment by the Lord of his church 144 years ago today.

title: Commitment to Serve
summary: I was born of goodly parents, and while they are on the other side, I have an assurance that my angel mother and my saintly father rejoice in this call. I love my family.

title: “I Will … Pour You Out a Blessing”
summary: With the rising cost of goods and services, inflation marches steadily onward. These increases result in hardships for many but especially upon individuals and families with fixed incomes. There are so many demands on each available dollar that constant adjustments are necessary to make ends meet. One frustrated person remarked: “I just get my affairs to the point where I think that I can make ends meet when something breaks loose in the middle.”

title: The Strength of Testimony
summary: We have sustained a new prophet at this conference, which is wonderful and inspiring. It’s necessary, for it is a commandment of God, but of course, the work is yet to do. We must follow him.

title: Hearken unto the Voice of God
summary: The Lord said, “… Hearken, O ye nations of the earth, and hear the words of that God who made you.” (.) Godliness in man goes undeveloped without the words of God and his program.

title: Sustaining of Church Officers
summary: Before we present the General Authorities and General Officers for the sustaining vote of this conference, we have a matter of business we should like to take up with you.

title: We Need to Continue in Righteousness
summary: My beloved brothers and sisters, I’m sure we all echoed with the choir “Thanks Be to God” for the opportunity we have to be gathered today under the direction of a prophet, Spencer W. Kimball.

title: The People Who Influence Us
summary: I feel like the young mother who was being wheeled into the delivery room and said, “I don’t believe I’ll go through with it.”

title: Birth
summary: Tomorrow, April 6, 1975, will be the 145th anniversary of the establishment of the Church upon the earth in this greatest and final of all the dispensations. By direct revelation we have been informed that tomorrow will also be the 1,975th anniversary of the birth of Jesus in Bethlehem of Judea.

title: Today Millions Are Waiting
summary: The greatest blessing that can come to mankind is to be numbered with the Saints of the Lord. Today there are millions of God’s children waiting to be taught the gospel of Jesus Christ. Yes, as Jesus said, “The harvest truly is great, but the labourers are few.” (.)

title: Help for Parents
summary: Several years ago I had as a special acquaintance and good friend an Aaronic Priesthood-age boy from whom I learned some of life’s special lessons. He came from what we commonly refer to as a good family, but his parents seemed to take the heart of the gospel for granted. They were willing to attend most of their meetings on Sunday, if it was convenient. They were warm people and friendly—always receptive to the brethren and sisters who came to their home. But I doubt if they had family prayer very often, and I’m sure family home evening was something occasionally discussed but seldom experienced. With no real personal attention, the children were allowed to come and go as they pleased.

title: The Roots of Mormonism
summary: We live in a world where almost no one knows anything for sure. The world seems to delight in jumping from one theory to the next, but that which was thought and purported to be the hope of the world only yesterday often turns out to become the bane of the world today.
