summary: Anne Marie Rose delivers a message titled "Facing Trials with Optimism."

title: My Prayers Were Answered
summary: Kirstin Boyer delivers a message titled "My Prayers Were Answered."

title: He Has Given Me a Prophet
summary: Anne Prescott delivers a message titled "He Has Given Me a Prophet."

title: An Anchor for Eternity—and Today
summary: Bonnie D. Parkin delivers a message titled "An Anchor for Eternity—and Today."

title: Finding Faith in Every Footstep
summary: Years from now your grandchildren will tell with amazement stories of your choices which changed their lives. You will be called their pioneers.

title: Keep Walking, and Give Time a Chance
summary: Our goal, our journey’s end, our Zion is life in the presence of our Heavenly Father. And to get there we are expected to walk and walk and walk.

title: Friends Standing Together
summary: Kristin Banner delivers a message titled "Friends Standing Together."

title: A Righteous Choice
summary: Fono Lavatai delivers a message titled "A Righteous Choice."

title: Draw Nearer to Christ
summary: Alejandra Hernández delivers a message titled "Draw Nearer to Christ."

title: Modern Pioneers
summary: We must have faith to walk away from those things that would tear us down or hold us back. … We must have faith in every footstep.

title: Turning Hearts to the Family
summary: Heavenly Father has a plan for His children and … families are the central part of that plan.

title: Understanding Our True Identity
summary: Long ago you and I were born as daughters in our Heavenly Father’s family. … Each one of you was a valiant and noble woman in your premortal life.

title: Young Women—Titles of Liberty
summary: You don’t have to be Captain Moroni to make a difference. Our Father in Heaven needs you to be who you are, in your family. He planned it that way.

title: Your Light in the Wilderness
summary: Keep your eyes riveted on your goal … and walk in the straight and narrow path of the Son—the Son of God.

title: Spiritual Power of Our Baptism
summary: How can we apply the spiritual power of our baptism to the principle of modesty? We hope one of the things that makes you different from the world is the way you dress.

title: Follow the Light
summary: The Lord invites us to come out of the cold danger of worldliness and into the warmth of His light.

title: Standing with God
summary: What does it mean to stand as a witness of God? It means we will not bow down or give in or be persuaded to do anything contrary to God’s will.

title: Integrity
summary: Integrity makes you whole and complete.

title: Stand as a Witness
summary: You have all you need to stand strong and firm and true because you have the Lord on your side.

title: Your Celestial Guide
summary: When you pray often and seek to know the Lord’s will like Nephi did, the Lord will show you the way.

title: Developing Our Talent for Spirituality
summary: Spirituality is learning how to listen to the Spirit and then letting it govern our lives.

title: A Comforter, a Guide, a Testifier
summary: By the gift and power of the Holy Ghost, you can be guided in your trip through life.

title: Standing in Holy Places
summary: Standing in holy places is all about being in good company, whether you are alone or with others.

title: Strengthen Home and Family
summary: Three principles that will help you strengthen your home and family are nurturing, sacrifice, and prayer.

title: Hold High the Torch
summary: Develop the divinity that is within you. Don’t dull the brightness of the spirit you came with from heaven. The Lord needs your goodness and your influence in this world.

title: There Is Hope Smiling Brightly before Us
summary: You can wake up every day … with hope smiling brightly before you because you have a Savior.

title: Press Forward and Be Steadfast
summary: You can press forward with vision. The Holy Ghost will help you remain steadfast, and your testimony of the Savior will help you proceed with a perfect brightness of hope.

title: My Soul Delighteth in the Scriptures
summary: If you have not already developed the habit of daily scripture study, start now and keep studying.

title: Believe!
summary: Believe in yourselves. Believe that you are never alone. Believe that you will always be guided.

title: A Work for Me to Do
summary: The Lord sent an angel to Joseph Smith to tell him that he had a work to do. That work continues today in us.

title: He Knows You by Name
summary: You may not have heard the Lord call you by name, but He knows each one of you and He knows your name.

title: You Have a Noble Birthright
summary: You can learn more about your life and mission on earth by preparing to receive and then studying your patriarchal blessing.

title: It Shows in Your Face
summary: You reflect His light. Your example will have a powerful effect for good on the earth.

title: Remembering, Repenting, and Changing
summary: The easiest, quickest path to happiness and peace is to repent and change as soon as we can.

title: Stay on the Path
summary: Sometimes we think we can live on the edge and still maintain our virtue. But that is a risky place to be.

title: At All Times, in All Things, and in All Places
summary: As you stand as a witness, obey the commandments, and press forward with “a steadfastness in Christ,” you will never be alone.

title: Be Thou an Example of the Believers
summary: The small and simple things you choose to do today will be magnified into great and glorious blessings tomorrow.

title: Come Let Us Go Up to the Mountain of the Lord
summary: Your personal virtue will … enable you to make the decisions that will help you be worthy to enter the temple.

title: Be of a Good Courage
summary: [The] guides from the book of Joshua will combine to provide the most powerful source of courage and strength there is: faith in our Heavenly Father and in His Son, Jesus Christ.

title: Remember Who You Are!
summary: There is no more beautiful sight than a young woman who glows with the light of the Spirit, who is confident and courageous because she is virtuous.

title: I Believe in Being Honest and True
summary: Being true to our beliefs—even when doing so isn’t popular, easy, or fun—keeps us safely on the path that leads to eternal life with our Heavenly Father.

title: Guardians of Virtue
summary: Prepare now so that you may qualify to receive all the blessings that await you in the Lord’s holy temples.

title: Arise and Shine Forth
summary: One of the greatest ways we can arise and shine forth is to confidently obey the commandments of God.

title: Now Is the Time to Arise and Shine!
summary: As daughters of God, you were born to lead.

title: Your Holy Places
summary: Whether [your holy places] are geographic or moments in time, they are equally sacred and have incredible strengthening power.

title: Be Not Moved!
summary: Stand firm. Be steadfast. “Stand for truth and righteousness.” Stand as a witness. Be a standard to the world. Stand in holy places.

title: The Welfare Production-Distribution Department
summary: The traditional Welfare Department was the forerunner of the Production-Distribution Department of Welfare Services. As in the past, efforts today in Welfare Production-Distribution are directed toward assisting priesthood officers and Relief Society leaders and the members of this worldwide church to fulfill the sacred obligation to care for the poor, the needy, the distressed, and those among us who are unable to care for themselves because of handicaps or other reasons, such as age.

title: The Developing Welfare Services Department
summary: A recently organized department of Welfare Services, the Developing Welfare Services Department, has been charged to promote the mission of Welfare Services by—

title: Acquiring and Managing Production Projects
summary: Brothers and sisters, this morning I’d like to elaborate on Bishop Brown’s welfare production challenge, which was for bishops and stake presidents to “become involved in a welfare services production project at the earliest possible time.” If your ward or wards are not involved in a production project, please see to it that during your administration they become so. It should be the right kind of project—one which will provide needed commodities for your bishops storehouse—thus assisting the area served by the storehouse to be self-sufficient in its ability to care for the poor and the needy. If your wards are already involved in a production project either on a ward or stake basis, be sure that ward members have opportunities to participate fully and that the project is operated as it should be. As you know, projects may be organized on either a ward, multiward, or stake basis. The key to this challenge is, of course, to accomplish this task during your time in office.

title: Principles of Welfare
summary: I would be ungrateful this morning if I didn’t express my appreciation for walking in the shadow of two great and holy men, Bishop Brown and Bishop Peterson, and for letting you know that I have a personal witness that J. Richard Clarke is a suited companion for these great men.

title: The Father’s Duty to Foster the Welfare of His Family
summary: I have been asked to speak on the father’s duty to foster the welfare of his family. After thinking many hours on this assignment, I am persuaded to make a few remarks in an attempt to teach a principle that, if understood and practiced, will make us all more effective in this God-given responsibility.

title: Successful Welfare Stewardship
summary: Brothers and sisters, I am so thankful to be involved in the great welfare plan of the Church. I testify from the depths of my soul that this great movement was revealed by Almighty God to his latter-day prophets.

title: Attending to Personal and Family Preparedness
summary: Brothers and sisters, this morning President Kimball has outlined for us standards of performance as they relate to the subject of personal and family preparedness. The filmstrip has refreshed our memories and hopefully inspired us to set goals and make preparations in areas of need.

title: Priesthood Administration of Welfare Services
summary: It’s a blessing to have the sweet companionship of the Relief Society, with their heaven-sent special sensitivities, beside us in this great Samaritan effort.

title: The Household of Faith
summary: My dear brothers and sisters, the greatest test for any generation is how it responds to the voice of the prophets. Our prophets have admonished us to—

title: “Is Any Thing Too Hard for the Lord?”
summary: At times, working on a Church welfare production project can seem to be largely a temporal experience. We may have just spent a long, hot day on one of our farms thinning, weeding, or lifting. Or perhaps we are returning home near midnight, knowing that we are expected to be on our own jobs at 7:00 after working a swing shift in one of our canneries. While we may have a tired but satisfying feeling inside, it may not register with us that much of it was a spiritual experience. Yet makes it clear that requirements the Lord places upon us are always spiritual. He says to us, in part, “And not at any time have I given unto you a law which was temporal.”

title: Love Extends beyond Convenience
summary: Brothers and sisters: Rikki Pace, the fifteen-year-old daughter of Glenn Pace, our new managing director of the Welfare Department, was overheard in a conversation with a school friend. It went something like this:

title: Finding Joy by Serving Others
summary: My dear brothers and sisters: We are happy as a couple to be able to speak to you today about how welfare principles have influenced our family through service.

title: Being Strengthened through Service
summary: Just five years ago last month, our family got involved in a situation that was quite unexpected at the time, but that has changed our entire family. We took a foster child into our home.

title: The Blessings of Family Work Projects
summary: The blessings that come from family work projects are both temporal and spiritual. The commandments given to Adam were spiritual, for the Lord himself said that he never gave to Adam a temporal commandment. (See .) Work, then, as instituted in the beginning of this earth, was a spiritual principle.
